_help: The Leonida map. One entry per place. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-map.mjs (writes dist/data/map.js; --check validates only). pos is [longitude, latitude] on the Florida-shaped stand-in outline, placed from the area a source names: precision 'area' = named town/district, position estimated; 'region' = only the region is known. pos null = no source says where yet (listed under Not placed yet). status follows the site's labels: Official, Tested, Reported, Patched, Unverified. A place may only be Tested with checked.on, checked.version and checked.platform. cat: weapon, vehicle, secret, money, mission, landmark, service.

regions.name: Vice City
regions.blurb: Neon, money and the biggest city in Leonida. Vice-Dale County.

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.blurb: Island chain and long bridges. Mariana County: Key Lento, where the story starts, and Mile Zero Air Station.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.blurb: Swamp, airboats and things with teeth.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.blurb: Faded Gulf town in Kelly County, next to Wild Hog Point.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.blurb: Sugar country by Lake Leonida. Raceway and refinery.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga
regions.blurb: Forest and rivers in Lummox County: Mount Kalaga National Park and the Kalaga Reservoir.

places.name: Mile Zero Air Station
places.summary: Military base on Goose Key at the far south-west end of the Leonida Keys, with Rhino tanks, combat jets and helicopters behind barbed wire. The fastest way to get a tank or a jet.
how: Wear body armour first: any sighting means an instant high Wanted Level.
Drive west from Key Lento through Abismo Key and Southwind; by road the base is only reachable from the east.
Easiest way in: the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump on the southern access road (a motorbike works well), or ram the main gate.
Tanks are left of the large building by the runway; jets are to the right, by the hangars. Escape in a P-996 Lazer.
Sources disagree: some details come from GTABase because PC Gamer’s page text could not be read beyond its headline.
places.reward: Rhino tank, P-996 Lazer jet, helicopters; the tank gives the 'Challenging Tank' trophy.
places.needs: Open from Chapter 1. Expect a 5-star Wanted Level, 6 if you start blowing things up.

places.name: Vice City International (VCIA)
places.summary: The airport. Two runways with commercial jets always parked, plus service vehicles and a terminal full of ATMs. Fan map-makers match it to the real Miami International Airport.
how: Sneak onto either main runway and take a parked jet.
Break into the ATMs in the central terminal.
places.reward: Commercial jets, Brute Ripley service vehicle, ATM cash

places.name: Assassin Nipper .38 cache
places.summary: A suppressed unique revolver in a hidden cache at the south tip of the eastern island of the Permit Keys. No fight needed.
how: Take a boat from Key Lento to the small Permit Keys island north of Abismo Key.
Scan the beached 'Derelict Spy Vessel' with the WAiNK app (it is a landmark), then climb aboard.
Use Focus Mode (L3+R3) to spot the floor compartment and open it to take the pistol.
Grab the meteorite lying on the same island a few steps from the boat.
Sources disagree: PC Gamer's two guides say 'south tip of the eastern island' and 'small island north of Abismo Key'; TheGamer only says an island near Southwind.
places.reward: Silenced Assassin Nipper .38 (kept in the weapon locker once equipped), a WAiNK landmark and a meteorite.

places.name: La Cascara Motel
places.summary: Kolt gang hideout in a ruined Port Gellhorn motel, called the most lucrative robbery in town: an LMG, a grenade launcher, the silenced Scrapper VF5C SMG, a unique car, drugs and cash.
how: Use the quieter south or middle stairs and stick to the outer walkways.
On the top floor, take the Scrapper VF5C (silenced SMG) and open the safe next door.
Sweep the lower floors for weed, pills, sticky bombs and cash, then steal the Vapid Firebug Dominator out front.
places.reward: Safe cash, Scrapper VF5C, grenade launcher, LMG, Firebug Dominator, drugs.
places.needs: Chapter 2; more than two bags of loot, so bring both characters. Safe code 6969 (GamesRadar+); some codes are randomised per player.

places.name: Kitty Litter labs (Tyrone's gold W-10)
places.summary: Tyrone's questline: blow up 19 Kitty Litter labs across Vice City by shooting the pink flask. Each lab pays, and finishing unlocks his unique gold W-10 SMG and his top narcotics prices. The first lab is the La Perle trailer park.
how: Meet Tyrone in Chapter 3 ('Dealer's Choice'); the first lab is in the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop / Ammu-Nation in La Perle.

Find the rest by the red smoking chimney and the blue-white Spin On This laundry van outside. Spots include the Decor District, behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, by Fleeca Field stadium, south of Vice City Hospital, behind Cross My Heart Tattoos and south-east of the Jack of Hearts.
One lab door south of Ron's Car Wash uses code 1999. Shoot the smoking pink flask, then run.
After 15 labs Tyrone calls with 'Spin On This'; finish it and collect the gold W-10 at his apartment.
places.reward: $2,000 per lab + $10,000 mission (about $48,000), the gold W-10 SMG, best narcotics prices.
places.needs: Chapter 3 (after 'Dealer's Choice'); a Snap Gun helps; some labs start shootouts.

places.name: Crosstown Police Station
places.summary: Cop car trunks hold assault rifles, shotguns and body armour. Randy's Pegassi Infernus is parked on the top floor of the station car park.
how: Police pickups: climb on the bed and open the crate. No alarm.
Cruisers: slim jim the door first, then the trunk opens without an alarm.
Infernus: Clone Key, drive to the top floor, leave over the stunt jump.
places.reward: Free guns and armour, Pegassi Infernus for Randy
places.needs: Slim jim from Moses (Chapter 2); Clone Key for the Infernus.

places.name: Chuck's Tackle & Shot
places.summary: The first gun store you visit, just down the road from Jason's house, and the earliest place to buy a mask to stay anonymous during crimes. Every Ammu-Nation also sells its own unique gun. Kirk's flyer is by the Ammu-Nation near Jason's place.
how: Enter the store and turn right, go forward, then left down the aisle: Neckwear is on the right.
Equip the mask and set Wear Style to 1 in the items menu to cover your face.
Body armor: the vest hangs on the wall to your right as you enter (PowerPyx, a fan guide).
places.reward: Masks, weapons and gear; a mask makes it harder for cops to identify you; body armor.

places.name: Badger R&D Tower
places.summary: Start of the Vice City easter egg: climb to the top and a GTA: Vice City sound plays. Substations across the map lead to a portal into old-school Vice City. The Thelma dancer card is at the top.
how: Climb the tower: inside stairs, then ladders.
Visit the substations: Downtown, Balsero, Key Lento, Penmarch Isle (Washington Beach), Crosstown, Port Gellhorn, Gloriana Key, south Port Gellhorn, North Mariana County.
Pull the lever by the portal.
places.reward: Tommy Vercetti shirt and motorcycle, for both Jason and Lucia

places.name: Jason's house (safehouse)
places.summary: Jason's Chapter 1 safehouse on Peach Palm Dr (via Calypso Ave). Hide cash under the bedroom floorboards so you don't lose it when wasted or busted, and grab five missable reading collectibles. Jason's boat is at the dock.
how: Stash cash under the bedroom floorboards until the Buck Me mission gives you a bank account; after that use ATMs.
Collect the books and magazines: kitchen table, round table, balcony, bedroom cabinet and the workshop below.
You leave the house in 'Home, Sweet Home', so do it all in Chapter 1.

places.name: Skunk Ape: first sighting
places.summary: GTA's Bigfoot. The first sighting is across Gambit Bay from Jason's house, at the dead-end road on the peninsula. It starts a questline: call Kirk, meet him in Gullet Marsh at night, then find three effigies.
how: Take Jason's boat across Gambit Bay to the dead-end road on the peninsula.
Follow the noises with Focus Mode (L3+R3) into the mangroves.
Call Kirk from the flyer outside the Key Lento Ammu-Nation and meet him in Gullet Marsh after dark.
Find three tree effigies in north-east, south-west and south-central Pelican Valley; they only show within about 50 feet.
places.reward: Starts the Skunk Ape questline with Kirk (PC Gamer gives no cash figure).
places.needs: Alligators and wild cats in the marsh.

places.name: Christmas House
places.summary: A house lit up with Christmas decorations at night, where Sunset Dr meets Laguna Dr. A WAiNK Curiosity, and the Nagasaki Rudolph Tao parked outside is a Standout Vehicle.
how: Scan the house and the car with WAiNK.
A stunt jump is south-east of the house, near Laguna Ln.

places.name: Exotic Animals Front (talking parrot)
places.area: Behind Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento
places.summary: An early illegal animal operation in the walled yard behind Three Sheets Liquor ('Strange Noises' on the map). A chatty caged parrot gives away a hidden cash stash; a backroom safe and the register add more.
how: Get into the yard behind Three Sheets Liquor: the right-hand alley, then the broken fence; deal with the guards.
Talk to the parrot in the cage in the middle of the yard and ask about the cash.
Open the wall vent beside the generator for the stash, then check the small safe.
places.reward: Hidden cash stash plus safe loot (fan guides report about $1,200-1,300 from the vent and $900-1,000 from the safe).
places.needs: Chapter 1; armed guards. A fan guide says do it before the Tourist Trap mission.

places.name: Kenton's shipwrecks
places.summary: Sunken Spanish wrecks with sets of treasure to find with a metal detector and sell to Kenton; he pays a little per item and more for a finished set. 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in total. Nuestra Señora de la Noche alone has 7.
how: Unlock diving with the 'Island Dreams' mission, then use Kenton's Huntress or the Rugger Fortune; scuba gear is on the boats or at Island Dreams.

Wrecks: south of Key Lento (de la Noche, de la Ética Laxa), off the south-east coast (Urca de Cinco Torres, Lujuriosa), east of Key Lento (Urca de Santa Sierra), and further west at Belpoint Strait and Bobcat Dive Site.
Anchor at a wreck, equip scuba gear and the metal detector (L1), and follow the beeps to glinting items.
Finish a set before selling to Kenton in Key Lento for the bigger payout.
places.reward: Cash from Kenton per item, more for complete sets.

places.name: BURG Facility #1 (underwater)
places.summary: One of five sunken BURG facilities, marked by a yellow platform sticking out of the water; each counts as an Underwater Discovery. Inside, a computer email gives the safe code; the safe holds a meteorite and another lies under the facility.
how: First dive to the research station under a yellow platform east of Key Lento and read the computer (WhatUp messages) to unlock 'Locate Underwater Meteorite' (Magic Game World, a fan site).
Find the yellow platform west of Mile Zero Air Station and dive.
Enter by the hatch at the 'Do Not Enter' sign.
Read the computer email and open the safe (80085).
The others: #2 east of Little Hardin Island, #3 west of Wild Hog Point, #4 north of Mile Zero Air Station, #5 east of Key Lento.
places.reward: Underwater Discovery and two meteorites (completes 'Locate Underwater Meteorite').

places.name: Watson Bay garages
places.summary: Wyman's classic cars: collect from the Paradise garage here, and a Reynolds Kit Car scrap sits behind Donnie's Auto Repair, next to the Pay 'n' Spray.
how: Follow the alley behind Donnie's Auto Repair; the Kit Car is in front of the shutters.
places.reward: Reynolds Kit Car part for Wyman

places.name: Old Fort Rd gas station
places.summary: An abandoned gas station north of Grassrivers Cafe & Deli hides a '70 Riata for Wyman.
how: Old Fort Rd, Shoreless Keys.

places.name: Paul Walker's car
places.summary: A green Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF, a tribute to Brian O'Conner's car from The Fast and the Furious, locked in a mansion garage on Vespucci Island. Available from Chapter 1; GamesRadar+ says it respawns if you lose it.
how: Drive to the centre of Vespucci Island; the mansion is just north of the two crossroads, with its entrance on the west side.
Break in through the garage door, not the glass door, to avoid the alarm; if it goes off, the alarm panel is on the wall to your left.
Open the garage from inside, then use a Slim Jim (from Moses, Chapter 2) or smash the window, hotwire it and drive.
Register it at a Pay 'n' Spray (about $6,750); GamesRadar+ says Moses registers your first steal for free.
Sources disagree on the way in: VGC uses the door to the right of the garage; TheGamer says use the garage door, not the glass door.
places.reward: Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF (green Fast & Furious tribute).
places.needs: No Key Cloner needed. A Slim Jim (Chapter 2) or a smashed window; about $6,750 to register unless it is your free first one.

places.name: Honeycomb Emerus
places.summary: One of the fastest cars, in a parking lot outside a dealership and car rental across from the hospital. Advanced security and trackers.
how: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).
Find the dealership and car-rental lot across the road from the hospital.
Clone the key and outrun the tracker: it calls the cops.
places.needs: Key Cloner (Chapter 3); advanced security and trackers, so mid-to-late game.

places.name: Dockyard container car
places.summary: A fast Emerus locked inside a shipping container at the dockyard. Trespassing gets you wanted.
how: Open the container with the cut-off tool.

places.name: Seaspray Emerus (north-west Capri garage)
places.summary: A race-spec Progen Emerus with its own livery (Dexerto lists speed 8.9, among the fastest standouts), in a garage in north-west Capri you open with the Snap Gun. Capri driveways also spawn the Pegassi Toros and the Buckingham Windsor Drop.
how: Unlock the Snap Gun (Chapter 3).
Open the garage in north-west Capri with it.
The car has every security feature and trackers, so plan the getaway.
places.needs: Snap Gun (Chapter 3); advanced security and trackers.

places.name: Boone Speedway
places.summary: A Truffade Thrax on a car-transporter trailer just outside the Boone Speedway entrance in south-west Hamlet, and Randy's Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire at the back of the M7 junkyard just east.
how: Thrax: check the trailer by the speedway entrance; if it is not there, come back later, then reverse it off the trailer carefully.
The Thrax has heavy security and a tracker, so you cannot keep it until later in the story.
Junkyard: off Galerina St; open the gates first, it is M7 gang turf.
Sources disagree: fan guides say the trailer car is random and may need several reloads.
places.reward: Truffade Thrax, Gauntlet Hellfire for Randy.

places.name: Piccia Furia at Peacock Estates (Randy)
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List sports car, the Piccia Furia, in the garage of a waterside mansion on Palladia Ln in Peacock Estates.
how: Skip the front gate; go left and hop the hedge.
Follow the path between the water and the garage and enter by its side door.
Clone the key, open the shutter and leave through the gates.

places.name: Leaf Links mansion
places.summary: Randy's Mamba GT is behind the building on the right. The key is in a bowl on the table behind the sofa. It has a tracker.
how: Get the key inside first, then drive straight to Randy and outpace the police.

places.name: Status Auto Imports
places.summary: The most common spawn for the Buckingham Windsor Drop. Leave through the windows on your left. The Y Hotel in Washington Beach often has one outside too.
how: Clone Key, then out through the windows to the left.

places.name: Ocelot Jugular at The Vault
places.summary: An Ocelot Jugular is sometimes parked outside; another is almost always in a garage on Atlantic Ave in Vice Beach.
how: If the garage is empty, leave and come back later.

places.name: Willie's Service Center
places.summary: The first Reynolds Kit Car scrap for Wyman: a blue and yellow building on SW 7th Ave, just north of the 7th Avenue Garage. Another scrap is on Casanova Island in the Rialto Islands.
how: SW 7th Ave, Salton.

places.name: Ocelot Bloodless Jugular
places.summary: A white Ocelot Bloodless Jugular on Randy's list that he cannot locate for you. It is in the garage of the southern house of a four-home cluster on Belville's northern edge. Randy pays $10,615, plus $5,000 if it's pristine.
how: Drive to northern Belville and find the four homes laid out in an X.
Break into the garage of the southernmost house; the owner is armed.
Use the Key Cloner; the tracker is standard and won't call the cops.
places.needs: Key Cloner. The owner is armed.

places.name: Waning Sands villa
places.area: Flamingo Pkwy, Waning Sands, Leonard County
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List supercar, the Pegassi Vitello, kept at a gated villa on Flamingo Pkwy east of Belville.
how: Hop the villa fence.
Push Square suggests planting explosives on the gate first, without setting them off.
Clone the key in the garage nearest the house (on the right as you face the entrance), then blow the gate and escape.

places.name: The Gellhorn bunker
places.summary: A foliage-covered bunker across from Burnout Scooters, near Moses' garage. It starts the missing tourists hunt and the serial-killer story.
how: See the missing-person posters, then call the Kelly County Tip Line.
Bodies: junkyard behind the Pay 'N' Spray; trailer park under the water tower (north); the U-shaped lake on the Wild Hog Point border.
Wait for the Tip Line to call back, then return to the bunker. Push Square suggests going alone.

places.name: Moses (car fence)
places.summary: Moses' auto shop is your first stolen-car buyer (Chapter 2). He wants older, low-profile cars with no tracker and pays $1,000 to $20,000 depending on the car, with a cooldown between sales. He gives you the Slim Jim and often says where the cars he wants are.
how: Finish 'Girls' Trip', then the 'Moses' mission.
Bring undamaged, tracker-free cars (check with the WAiNK app).
After one sale he will not buy again for a while. He pays around $3,400 for the BF Bandito.

places.name: Bud and the UFO
places.summary: At night Bud stands on his car shouting at the sky near the beach in south Kelly County. After you talk, drive the dirt roads in the central Gellhorn woods until the radio cuts out.
how: Meet Bud after dark (around 8:30pm worked for Push Square), alone.
Find the abandoned car pointing into the woods and follow the trail of clothes.
places.reward: The Truth Is Out There trophy

places.name: Wild Hog Point coast
places.summary: A Reynolds Kit Car scrap in a Scoop shipping container on the coast far west of Port Gellhorn.
how: Look for the Scoop container on the shore.

places.name: Wyman's '64 Mamba GT wrecks
places.summary: Wyman's third classic-car restoration (Ultimate Edition): scan four '64 Mamba GT wrecks. One is in a farmhouse garage north of the Leonida State Prison, on the east side of Gellhorn.
how: Scan all four wrecks: a farmhouse garage north of Leonida State Prison, a pond by Thrillbilly Mud Club, an alley in Ambrosia, and under a broken bridge in northern Moreau.
Pay the fee in BuckMe and collect the restored car.

places.name: Paradise Wines Vineyard Bar
places.summary: A Pegassi Toros is often parked outside.
how: Check the car park.

places.name: Ambrosia Raceway demolition derby
places.summary: Repeatable demolition derbies on an oval and a figure-eight. You win by default once every other car is wrecked, so it is quick money even for bad drivers. On the west side of the highway heading north out of Ambrosia.
how: Go to Ambrosia Raceway and enter a demolition race; you can rent a car at the track for a few hundred dollars.
Ram and wreck every other car; you win when you are the last car running.
Repeat as often as you like. The figure-eight pays about double the oval.
Sources disagree on pay: $3,800-$6,300 a win (PC Gamer, as quoted by gta6.house) or $1,900/$3,150 (another guide).
places.reward: $3,800-$6,300 per win (PC Gamer); the figure-eight pays about double the oval.
places.needs: A rental fee if you don't bring your own car.

places.name: Xero Gas alley Mamba GT
places.summary: A '64 Mamba GT down the alley next to the Xero Gas Station, between US-35 and Lakewood Way.
how: Follow the alley south from the Xero Gas Station.

places.name: Trailer south of Grassrivers
places.summary: A trailer safe whose code is hidden in the postcards on the trailer wall. GamesRadar+ lists it as 44017.
how: Find the trailer south of Grassrivers, with postcards pinned on its wall.
Use Focus Mode on the postcards to read the numbers.
Enter the code. GamesRadar+ lists 44017, but that is five digits while other safes take four, so check in game.
places.reward: Safe contents (the guides do not say what is inside).
places.needs: Some safe codes are randomised per player; read the postcards in your own game.

places.name: BF Bandito swamp loop
places.summary: The white off-road racer circles a marked search area in the swamp. Block the track with your car and he stops. Moses pays about $3,400.
how: Park across the track and stand by it; press L2 to focus when he calls out.
His friends chase you out of the swamp; the Bandito outruns them.

places.name: Kalaga Reservoir mine
places.area: Mount Kalaga National Park, Lummox County
places.summary: The abandoned mine where the Port Gellhorn serial-killer story ends.
how: Finish the Gellhorn bunker story first; the meeting point is sent to your partner's phone.
places.needs: After the missing tourists in Port Gellhorn.

places.name: Lake Tallaloko houses
places.summary: Properties here can spawn a Buckingham Windsor Drop.
how: Check the driveways.

places.name: Bret Vogel (Killtelligence hunting)
places.summary: Jason's old military buddy pays more and more for the animals he asks for.
how: Jason only.
Chapter 2: answer Bret's text and meet him (Veteran Hunted).
Complete his hunting decks.

places.name: Jet Ski Dog
places.summary: A dog on a jet ski rescues you at sea. Leave your boat in open water, away from other boats and islands; after a few minutes Cool Dog picks you up, drops you on a beach and leads you to a dead man’s wallet.
how: Boat out into open water (Gambit Bay works) and swim away from the boat, far from other boats and islands.
Wait a few minutes and listen for barking.
Ride with Cool Dog to the beach and follow him to the wallet.
GamesRadar+ found it in Leonida Bay; players report other spots too.
places.needs: None; the spawn spot is not fixed.

places.name: McKittrick Farm
places.summary: Crop-dusting job for Kyle: dust three fields, then land on the strip. An abandoned dino mini golf nearby hides a Vice City Flamingos card, according to a reader.
how: Fly over the pink areas on the mini map, then land and talk to Kyle.

places.name: Brooks Boatworks safe
places.summary: A Kolt & Associates hideout full of cash, pills and explosives in north Port Gellhorn, just right of the larger bridge. Safe code 6823, from a wall map that also lists the Kingpin Bowling and La Cascara Motel codes.
how: Skip the main gate; use the unlocked gate to the right and the gap in the fence.
In the smallest building, take the Clunker 556 and read the wall map with the safe codes (or threaten staff for them).
Climb onto the warehouse roof on its right side and drop in; the safe (6823) is in the room with a pool table.
Grab the launcher on the top floor above the safe room, and check the west building's second safe (no code).

Sources disagree: PC Gamer says the code map is in the smallest building near the fence gap; VGC and GamesRadar+ say an office on the east side up an external staircase. PC Gamer's bowling guide calls the area north-west Port Gellhorn.
places.needs: Chapter 2 (first visited in 'Slam Dunk'); many armed guards, stealth advised. Some safe codes are randomised per player.
places.reward: Safe cash, drugs, Clunker 556 rifle, launcher, Smuggler Caracara 4x4.

places.name: Royal Ruby Emerus
places.area: Vespucci Mansion, Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands
places.summary: A blood-red custom Progen Emerus parked at a drug lord's mansion. Game Rant says it has no lock and no tracker, making it one of the best free supercars early on. Where: Outside the guarded Vespucci Mansion on Vespucci Island, the middle Rialto island between Vice City and Vice Beach.
how: Drive to Vespucci Island and drop a pin on the Vespucci Mansion.
Hop the front fence; guards patrol the roof and halls.
Optionally loot the two safes and the Kingpin Heathen rifle inside first.
Open the gate, get in the Emerus and drive off.
Sources disagree: Guides describe the exact parking spot differently (by the gate vs in a garage on the south side).
places.reward: Progen Emerus (no lock, no tracker); Game Rant: about $30k to sell in top condition, similar to register.
places.needs: Armed guards on site. Registration needs Moses (Chapter 2) or a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Purple Drank Emerus
places.area: Chatfield Storage & Logistics robbery, Waxman Island
places.summary: A pearlescent purple Emerus stashed by car thieves. Game Rant says it sits in a shipping container, needs no key and has no tracker; it has nitrous but no storage slots. Where: At the Waxman Island robbery opportunity (Chatfield Storage & Logistics), east of downtown Vice City.
how: Go to the robbery site on Waxman Island.
Deal with the gang members; Game Rant gives the shack safe code as 5800.
Press the gate button so you have a clear exit.
Take the Emerus out of its container and drive away.
Sources disagree: Game Rant puts the site on the east of Waxman Island; other guides say the west side.
places.reward: Nitrous-equipped Progen Emerus; about $29,000 to register.

places.name: Black Widow Emerus
places.summary: A Progen Emerus locked in a yellow SCOOP container at the docks. GamesRadar says it is unlocked and deactivated once you are inside. Where: Inside the one openable SCOOP shipping container at the Vice City County Dockyard.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool in the Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders.
Go to the Vice City County Dockyard (you are trespassing).
Use Focus mode to find the one container you can open; evade or knock out security.
Cut the lock and drive out fast before police close in.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3); restricted area with security.

places.name: Andrew Node's Thrax
places.summary: A modified Truffade Thrax that GamesRadar ranks as the fastest car in the game. No keys or trackers, but $70,000 to register. Where: Behind a pair of garage doors on the west side of a building on Starfish Island.
how: Legit route: scan 10 of the 15 No Flusher tags around Vice Beach with WAiNK It and follow the group-chat clues.
Glitch route (may be patched): wedge a car diagonally against the garage doors, crouch in the gap and open your phone to clip inside.
Open the doors from the inside panel and drive off before security reacts.
places.needs: Private property with security; the glitch may be patched.

places.name: Truffade Thrax (Randy finale)
places.area: Dalton Island Club, southeast corner of Leonida
places.summary: The last car on Randy's Wish List, unlocked as the optional mission 'Steal the Truffade Thrax' once every other list car is delivered. Where: Parked directly opposite Spa Spendido at the Dalton Island Club, reached by ferry or from Gloriana Key.
how: Deliver all other Randy's Wish List cars.
Start 'Steal the Truffade Thrax' from Touch Pad > Story > Optional.
At Dalton Island Club, quietly deal with the two guards.
Clone the key, drive onto the ferry, lose the 3-star wanted level on arrival and park in Randy's garage.
places.reward: Completes Randy's list, leading to Delivery Day and Raul's Tempesta.
places.needs: Key Cloner; two guards; 3-star wanted level when you land.

places.name: Raul's Pegassi Tempesta (reward)
places.summary: The final reward for Randy's Wish List. It is registered to you automatically and comes with the Domestic Timbers garage. Where: Inside the Balsero garage that Randy texts you after the Wish List is complete.
how: Finish every Randy's Wish List car, including the Thrax.
Complete Delivery Day ($25,000 and the Supply & Demand trophy).
After Randy calls and texts, drive to the Balsero garage and collect the car.
places.reward: Pegassi Tempesta, auto-registered, plus the Domestic Timbers garage.
places.needs: Whole Randy's Wish List (Key Cloner, Chapter 3+).

places.name: Gold Rush Tempesta
places.area: Cirque de Cuisine, Ocean Beach, Vice Beach
places.summary: A gold Pegassi Tempesta from the Blinged Up standout set, protected by advanced security. Where: Outside the Cirque de Cuisine restaurant in Ocean Beach.
how: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).
Check outside Cirque de Cuisine in Ocean Beach.
Clone the key and deal with the tracker before registering.
Sources disagree: Some guides place it in the car park at Crimson Palms Condominiums, Washington Beach, instead.

places.name: Mojito Tempesta
places.summary: A Pegassi Tempesta with its own street-racer livery (Dexerto speed 8.2). Where: Outside a hotel in Tequesta Retreat.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pegassi '96 Infernus (Randy)
places.area: Crosstown Police Station lockup, Crosstown, Vice City
places.summary: The only sports car in the police car park: a purple Infernus wanted by Randy. It carries a tracker. Where: On level 7 of the multi-storey police lockup next to the Crosstown Police Station.
how: Wait until Randy texts its location; PC Gamer says a yellow window-cleaning lift then appears on the south side.
Ride the lift in, or slip in behind a police car at the gate.
Go up to level 7, clone the key, and drive out fast so the tracker does not ping police.
Sources disagree: Push Square and GTA-Xtreme give NW 9th St; PC Gamer calls the lockup the building west of the station in southwest Crosstown. Some guides write NE 9th St.
places.reward: Pegassi Infernus for Randy, or keep it.

how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pegassi Toros (stock)
places.area: Pegassi Residences, Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat
places.summary: The game's Urus-style SUV and a Randy's Wish List car. GTA-Xtreme saw one here around 6:30 pm in-game, but the space can be empty. Where: Outside the entrance to Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr.
how: Visit Bayside Dr in early evening.
Watch for security at the entrance.
Clone the key if it is locked and keep moving if it has an advanced tracker.
places.needs: Key Cloner; security at the entrance; spawn not guaranteed.

places.name: Lustrous Toros (gold)
places.summary: The viral gold 'Lamborghini Urus' is the Pegassi Lustrous Toros. It has an alarm and an advanced tracker. Where: Inside the closed garage beside a pale mansion on the south side of the road through the middle of Casanova Island.
how: Drive to Casanova Island, east of Vespucci Island.
Lift the garage door next to the mansion by hand.
Scan the car and use the Key Cloner.
Take the cash and collectible card from the workbench, then lose the police.
Sources disagree: One outlet calls the Casanova gold SUV a Charred Toros; the Charred Toros is a different car in La Perle.
places.reward: Gold Pegassi Toros, plus cash and a collectible card in the garage.
places.needs: Key Cloner (Chapter 3); alarm and advanced tracker.

places.name: Charred Toros
places.area: La Perle trap house, NW 10th Ave
places.summary: A donk-converted Toros kept by San4San. GTA-Xtreme found it unlocked with no tracker, making it an easy early rare car. Where: In the front yard of a fenced single-storey trap house on NW 10th Ave, south of the highway interchange in La Perle.
how: Approach from the neighbouring lot to the side or rear fence.
Scan it with WAiNK.
If it is unlocked, get in and drive off past the armed guards.
places.reward: Donk Pegassi Toros; GTA-Xtreme estimates about $9,000 to register.

places.name: DriveShaft Gauntlet (Dom's Charger)
places.summary: A rusty blue Bravado Gauntlet with a hood blower, styled after Dom Toretto's Charger. Where: Behind Sid Thompson's wooden house, northeast of the Grayson town marker near the railway by San Malo Bay.
how: Drive to Grayson in northern Leonida.
Go behind Sid Thompson's house.
Get in and drive off.
Sources disagree: Some guides say it is in a shed, others that it is parked behind the house.

places.name: Vanessa's Growler (pink)
places.area: Del Rio Boulevard Garage, La Perle
places.summary: A baby-pink Pfister Growler (Porsche Cayman look) left as a gift for Vanessa. GamesRadar says it is free to take and keep. Where: In a lock-up next to Auntie's Place in La Perle.
how: In Chapter 3, move into Vanessa's Bayside apartment and work out her laptop password.
Read the WhatUp thread from 'Unknown' on the laptop: it points to La Perle and gives the code 92665.
Go to the Del Rio Boulevard Garage in southern La Perle, behind Auntie's Place (a bow is graffitied by the door), and enter 92665.
You keep the garage too: one vehicle space plus a weapon locker. gta6.house values the car at about $22,660; Moses buys it for $14,750.
Sources disagree: GTABase calls it a Rockridge lockup.
places.needs: Chapter 3 only and missable: get it before The Cartel Heist ends the chapter. Laptop password.

places.name: Bloodbath Phoenix
places.summary: A supercharged '77 Imponte Phoenix with a custom design. Where: At an illegal chop shop in Salton.
how: Find the chop shop in Salton.
Scan the Phoenix with WAiNK and steal it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Firebug Dominator
places.area: La Cascara Motel, Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
places.summary: A supercharged custom Vapid Dominator and one of the motel's key valuables. Where: Parked outside La Cascara Motel, the Kolt & Associates hideout at the northwest end of Port Gellhorn.
how: Unlock the motel robbery by finishing June Warehouse or Brooks Boatworks.
Deal with the Kolt guards.
Break the window, hotwire and drive off.
It is locked, with an alarm and no tracker (gta6map.io). Ordinary Dominators also spawn in traffic, and race-prepped ones at Gellhorn Raceway.
places.needs: Chapter 2; Kolt gang guards. Moses can register it ($2,950, or your free first registration).

places.name: Devil's Rope Gauntlet

Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Biker gang site. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.area: Galerina St, Hamlet, South Vice-Dale County
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List muscle car parked at the rear of a junkyard. Where: At the back of a junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet.
how: Sneak along the right side of the junkyard, staying low.
Open the entrance gates for an exit.
Clone the key on the car at the back and leave quickly.
Sources disagree: Push Square calls it the M7 junkyard; Game Rant says Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet.

places.name: Mamba GT (¡Dale Mamba!)
places.summary: Added to Randy's list through the mission ¡Dale Mamba!. The key is inside the main house. Where: Behind the right-hand building at a heavily guarded mansion in Leaf Links.
how: Hop the fence and take the right-hand path to avoid guards.
Enter the building behind the pool (Snap Gun) and take the key from the bowl behind the sofa.
Return to the car and escape; it has a tracker.
places.reward: Mamba GT for Randy or the Delivery Day run.

places.name: Declasse Vamos (Moses)
places.area: Rockledge Rd, Grayson, South West Lummox County
places.summary: A red muscle car Moses wants. The garage code 2727 is on tin signs inside the shack and is the same for every player. Where: In a keypad-locked garage beside a shack covered in road signs, just outside Grayson.
how: Drive to the shack near Grayson.
Read the code inside, or just enter 2727.
Open the garage, take the car and lose any chase.
Sources disagree: GamesRadar says just north of Grayson; Push Square says just east.
places.reward: Counts toward Moses' seven drop-offs (Emperor Sultan reward).

places.name: Emperor Sultan (Moses reward)
places.summary: The reward for finishing Moses' drop-off side jobs, which work as a tutorial for Randy's Wish List. Where: Gifted by Moses in Port Gellhorn after all seven Vehicle Drop-Offs.
how: Unlock the drop-offs in Port Gellhorn in Chapter 2.
Deliver all seven cars (Crawler, Yosemite, Bandito, Hellion, Futo, Nightblade, Vamos).
Collect the Sultan and register it.

places.name: Karin Futo (Moses)
places.area: Draper Island, northwest of Port Gellhorn
places.summary: A Moses drop-off car inside a high-security building. Where: Behind the shutters in the postal building warehouse at the southern tip of Draper Island.
how: Enter by the northwest door nearest the railway.
Go through the office into the warehouse.
Start the engine before opening the shutters, then lose the police.

places.name: Western Nightblade (Moses)
places.summary: A chopper Moses wants, guarded inside the biker clubhouse. Where: At the Final Chapter motorcycle club on Birch St in Ambrosia.
how: Climb the roof ladder or drop in through a roof window.
Knock out the gate guard and open the gate.
Distract the bike guard with a bottle, hotwire it and ride to Moses.

places.name: Vapid '32 Hustler (Dubious Provenance)

how: Play Dubious Provenance (Chapter 3).
Accept Halifax's offer, trust him at the motel and finish Evelyn's final request.
At the final scene, loot the container and take the Hustler.
Sources disagree: VGC says sparing Halifax gives the full reward; some fan guides say the Hustler comes either way.
places.reward: Vapid '32 Hustler plus about $2,500 in cash and jewellery.
places.needs: Chapter 3; fan guides say the optional parts vanish at the end of Chapter 3.

how: The Balsero warehouse is the Leonida Carrier Warehouse robbery (map card: gunshots from the warehouse).
Way in: the caged ladder or the metal stairs by the railway to the flat roof, then the open roof hatch.
Three armed men guard the truck in the garage; clear them, open the roll-up shutter and drive out.
Other valuables there: a safe (code 9256), a GRX 556 rifle and a watch.

how: Collect the '67 Dominator buggy in Chapter 2 to start Find Cars for Wyman.
Scan the three Port Gellhorn wrecks with WAiNK.
Pay the $1,500 mechanics fee in BuckMe and collect the car.

places.name: '70 Riata (Wyman)
places.area: Key Lento, Southwind and Shoreless Keys, Mariana County
places.summary: Second Wyman restoration (Ultimate Edition). Where: Three wrecks: Sunset Dr in Key Lento, Cangrejo St in Southwind, and behind an abandoned gas station on Old Fort Rd, Shoreless Keys.
how: Scan the three Keys wrecks with WAiNK.
Pay Wyman's fee in BuckMe.
Collect it, then register at a Pay 'n' Spray ($100) or park it in your garage.

places.name: Reynolds Kit Car (Wyman)
places.area: Salton, Casanova Island, Wild Hog Point, Watson Bay, Capri
places.summary: Fourth and hardest Wyman restoration; one wreck sits inside a container. Where: Five wrecks: Willie's Service Center in Salton, a north Casanova Island garage, a SCOOP container at Wild Hog Point, Donnie's Auto Repair in Watson Bay, and a Capri garage.
how: Scan the Salton wreck quickly, because breaking in sets off an alarm.
Use the Cut-Off Tool on the Wild Hog Point SCOOP container.
Scan all five, pay Wyman and collect.
places.needs: Ultimate Edition only; Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3) for the container.

places.name: '72 Deviant (Wyman finale)
places.area: Wyman's Auto Salvage, edge of Capri

how: Finish the first four Wyman cars.
Wait for Wyman's call and pay the fee.
Collect the Deviant from his scrapyard.
Sources disagree: Push Square says the fee is $1,000; fan sites say $1,500.

how: Meet Wyman through the motel safehouse in Chapter 2.
Complete a Dirt Track Race at Thrillbilly Mud Club.
Follow the Exploration task to collect the buggy and garage.
Sources disagree: Push Square names the pickup as the Paradise garage in Watson Bay.

Follow the Exploration task to the Ocean View Hotel and collect it.
places.reward: Styled '55 Vapid Stainer plus Bonita Court Garage.

places.name: Army Dinka Enduro and Crest Kayak (Ultimate Edition)

how: Leave Jason's house in Chapter 1.
The army-pattern Enduro is in the driveway; the kayak is out back.
places.reward: Army-pattern Dinka Enduro motorbike and a Crest Kayak.

places.name: Hauners Rhino tank
places.area: Mile Zero Air Station, Goose Key, Mariana County
places.summary: The main military tank, reachable from Chapter 1. Getting in unlocks the Challenging Tank trophy/achievement. Where: A row of tanks to the left of the large building beside the runway at Mile Zero Air Station.
how: Drive west through Abismo Key to Southwind and the base.
Use the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump to clear the fence.
On the runway turn left, smash through the fence by the tanks and climb in.
Sources disagree: GamesRadar says taking it keeps you at 2 stars until you shoot; other guides report 5 stars at once.
places.needs: Body armour advised; wanted level reaches 5-6 stars once you fire; slow and can run out of fuel.

places.name: Hauners P996-Lazer jet
places.area: Mile Zero Air Station, Goose Key, Mariana County
places.summary: A combat jet you can steal from Chapter 1. Expect at least 5 stars and enemy jets with homing missiles. Where: Jets parked by the hangars along the Mile Zero runway.
how: Make a manual save.
Get in via the stunt jump, or speed past the gate guards on a fast bike.
Pull up by a jet, climb into the cockpit and take off; retract the gear.
Fly low to dodge missiles.
Sources disagree: GamesRadar says drive straight ahead on the runway; Screen Rant says veer right.
places.needs: 5-star wanted level, up to 6 if you destroy things.

places.name: Botticher Buzzard helicopter

how: Break into Mile Zero Air Station.
Find the helicopter area and take off.

how: Get into the base.
Check the tank/APC areas and take one.

how: Talk to Jose Bermudez at the Friends of Freedom memorial, Catalan Blvd, Downtown.
Visit his Little Cuba flat, then the President's Bunker on an island north of Waning Sands (door 010317, safe 2975).
Open the hatch with 085355, restore power and open the hangar.
places.reward: Free Ridgway tank; Cold War 556 rifle in the same hangar.
places.needs: First bunker is on an island, so bring a boat.

places.name: Buckingham Maverick (Southwind dock)

how: Take Route 1 southwest through Key Lento and Abismo Key to Southwind.
Turn into the SBW / Chicki's Tiki Bar car park.
Walk through the open gate onto the dock and fly off.
places.needs: None; TheGamer says a helicopter is likely but not guaranteed.

places.name: Mammoth Dodo seaplane (Southwind)

how: Go to the SBW car park in Southwind.
Face the water and look right for the hangar.
Take one from the dock or drive it into the water and take off.

how: Climb the side chain-link fence instead of using the gate.
Walk to the pad carefully and fly off.

Climb in and take off.
