how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Pharaoh Sanchez
places.summary: A race-modded one-off Maibatsu Sanchez dirt bike. Where: By a residence at Wild Hog Point.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Emilio's Lectro
places.summary: A bespoke Principe Lectro with a custom livery and racing mods (Dexerto speed 7.4). Where: At Emilio's Auto Center in Rockridge.
how: Go to the spot named above.
Scan it with the WAiNK It app to check its lock and tracker, then take it.
places.needs: Lock and tracker not stated by the source. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Bravado Banshee (Sweetbay Inn)
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List sports car that GTA-Xtreme saw here around 3 am in-game. Where: In the parking spaces outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Drive.
how: Visit the Sweetbay Inn around 3 am in-game.
Clone the key if it is locked.
Sources disagree: Game Rant says list Banshees spawn randomly at homes in rich Capri.

places.name: Ubermacht Cypher (Randy)
places.summary: One of the few Randy's Wish List cars Game Rant gives a named spot for. Where: Parked outside Cirque de Cuisine on Ocean Beach.
how: Check outside Cirque de Cuisine.
Clone the key and deliver it.
places.needs: Key Cloner; Game Rant says most list cars have a tracker.

places.name: Kingfishers W-22 rifle
places.summary: A unique rifle with red dot sight and suppressor already fitted, lying in an open case during the Fishing Shacks illegal operation. Cocaine bricks in the same shacks sell to Donnie or Brian. Where: Inside the large red house on the dock at the Kingfisher gang's Fishing Shacks in Wetman Bay, a water-only spot in southwest Pelican Valley.
how: Do a few story missions until Donnie offers the Fishing Shacks robbery (gold icon with black crocodile).
Sail Jason's fishing boat to Wetman Bay and fight through the Kingfisher gang.
Enter the large red house on the dock, kill the guard, and take the rifle from the case on the left table.
The Fishing Shacks are one of the Kingfisher gang's hideouts (vicecity.codes, a fan site, says north-west of Key Lento).
places.reward: Kingfishers W-22 (red dot + suppressor), cocaine bricks to sell
places.needs: Boat access only; heavy gang fight, bring a long rifle or shotgun and full health.

places.name: Free H-AT rocket launcher + Conspiracist Type 9
places.summary: An unguarded hidden armory that holds the Hauners H-AT launcher, the unique Conspiracist Type 9 SMG and Zombix, reachable as soon as the prologue is done. Where: In an underground bunker reached through a trailer with antennas, in an abandoned yard just west of the Griffin Firing Range in Balsero.
how: Finish the prologue, then drive north to Vice City and on to Balsero.
Find the Griffin Firing Range; go through the unlocked gate of the yard just west of it.
Enter the trailer with antennas, turn left and lift the bunker door.
Take the H-AT launcher beside the safes, plus the Conspiracist Type 9 and Zombix. Stow the launcher in your car trunk.
places.reward: Hauners H-AT rocket launcher, Conspiracist Type 9 unique SMG, Zombix
places.needs: Prologue done. Firing the launcher in the open can start a police chase. Safes there can't be looted.

places.name: Couch Potato Mustang .357
places.summary: A unique revolver variant of the Duke Mustang .357 tucked inside a couch strung up in a tree. Where: Hidden in a couch hanging from a tree outside a mobile home off Tanglewood Ln in Port Gellhorn.
how: Go to the mobile home off Tanglewood Ln, Port Gellhorn.
Shoot the ropes to drop the couch.
Sit on the couch to find the revolver.

places.name: Drug Mule KZ-59 (underwater)
places.summary: A unique KZ-59 assault rifle in a speedboat wreck; floating drug packages on the surface mark the spot. Where: Underwater beneath a sunken speedboat off the north coast of Riquezas Keys, north-west of Mile Zero Air Station.
how: Head to the north coast of Riquezas Keys, north-west of Mile Zero Air Station.
Look for floating drug packages.
Dive to the sunken speedboat below and take the rifle.
places.needs: A boat and diving; scuba gear helps.

places.name: Shark Knife (underwater)
places.area: North of the Saint Attaway Islands
places.summary: A unique melee knife found on the sea floor next to a shark cage. Where: Stuck in the seabed beside a shark cage in an underwater ravine north of the Saint Attaway Islands.
how: Sail north of the Saint Attaway Islands.
Dive into the underwater ravine and find the shark cage.
Pick the knife out of the seabed beside it.

places.name: Swamp Bait Akulus revolver
places.summary: A unique Akulus revolver that Dexerto rates S-tier, lying on a shack floor in the marshes. Where: On the floor of a waterfront shack in the marsh south-west of Hamlet.
how: Travel to the marsh south-west of Hamlet.
Find the waterfront shack and pick the revolver up off the floor.

Sources disagree: Fan guides seen in search (not opened) put it at a hunter's cabin in Pelican Valley next to the Cruel Huntsman's SM-69; Dexerto says a shack in the marsh south-west of Hamlet. These may be the same area.
places.needs: None listed; wildlife in the marsh.

places.name: Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 sniper
places.summary: A unique SM-69 sniper rifle that Dexerto rates S-tier, free to pick up at a marsh cabin. Where: On the boardwalk of a hunter's cabin in the Pelican Valley marsh, next to some gator carcasses.
how: Go to the Pelican Valley marsh.
Find the hunter's cabin with gator carcasses by it.
Take the rifle from the boardwalk.

places.name: Crabshack VF5 SMG
places.summary: A unique Vom Feuer military SMG behind a keypad door at a derelict research outpost. Where: In the boat shack of an abandoned research outpost in Pelican Valley, behind a code-locked door on the boardwalk.
how: Go to the abandoned research outpost in Pelican Valley.
Find the boat shack door on the boardwalk and enter its code.
Take the SMG inside.
Get there by water from the Stillwater Path dock, north-east of the Pelican Valley and Gullet Marsh map labels.
Codes (Game Rant): computer password CLEAVES, safe 0072, boathouse door 0212.
places.needs: The door code (Dexerto does not print it; it is found at the outpost).

places.name: Cold War 556 (bunker)
places.summary: A unique 556 rifle (A-tier per Dexerto) inside a bunker tied to the 'Big War' hatch-finding puzzle. Where: Leaning on a crate just inside a bunker in Big Pine, North Mariana County.
how: Go to Big Pine in North Mariana County.
Find the bunker hatch (part of the Big War puzzle).
Take the rifle leaning on the crate inside.
places.needs: Finding the hatch; Dexerto gives no step-by-step route.

places.name: Turnt Nipper .38
places.area: Bobcat Bight, west of North Mariana County
places.summary: A unique Nipper pistol left on a paratrike stuck in a tree. Where: On the seat of a crashed paratrike caught in a tree at the northern tip of Bobcat Bight.
how: Go to the northern tip of Bobcat Bight.
Find the crashed paratrike in the tree and take the pistol from its seat.

places.name: Cockroach Xtreme 556 (Sunrise Motel)
places.summary: A unique 556 rifle hidden in a motel garage. Dexerto also lists the Deever Tech GLR40 grenade launcher at this garage. Where: Behind a stack of toilet paper in a one-car garage in the Sunrise Motel courtyard, Tequesta.
how: Go to the Sunrise Motel in Tequesta.
Open the one-car garage in the courtyard.
Look behind the toilet paper stack for the rifle.
Sources disagree: Dexerto's GLR40 page says the grenade launcher at this garage 'costs $15,500'; fan guides seen in search describe it as a free pickup.

places.name: Pete's KZ-59
places.summary: A unique KZ-59 rifle you pick up during one of Pilot Pete's side quests. Where: On a table in the back room behind the red door of the hangar at Sundown Private Airfield.
how: Progress Pilot Pete's side quests (Pete appears in Chapter 3).
At Sundown Private Airfield, go through the red door in the hangar.
Take the rifle from the back-room table.
places.needs: Available during a Pilot Pete side quest.

places.name: Twin's Laird 350
places.summary: A unique Laird 350 rifle lying under a hunting stand in the northern woods. Where: On the ground below a small hunting platform in the woods just east of Kalaga Reservoir, Lummox County.
how: Go to the woods just east of Kalaga Reservoir in Lummox County.
Find the small hunting platform and check the ground under it.

places.name: Black Eagle warehouse weapons
places.summary: Two unique guns in one building: the M306 TMR in a case past a gap only Lucia fits through, and the Black Eagle Import Kalinga pistol in the office safe. Where: Inside the Black Eagle warehouse next to the Black Eagle gun store in Balsero.
how: Go to the Black Eagle warehouse beside the Black Eagle store in Balsero.
As Lucia, squeeze through the gap behind the boxes to reach the case with the M306 TMR.
Read the safe code on the office computer and open the office safe for the Kalinga pistol.
places.reward: Black Eagle Import M306 TMR (S-tier per Dexerto), Black Eagle Import Kalinga pistol

places.name: Backdoor Hobo at Zenon's Pawn Shop
places.summary: A unique shotgun that is only sold at Zenon's Pawn Shop, for $2,502. Where: Sold at Zenon's Pawn Shop (a gun-selling pawn shop) in La Perle, opposite a trailer park.
how: Go to Zenon's Pawn Shop in La Perle.
Buy the Backdoor Hobo.

places.name: Free guns and body armor from police cars
places.area: Police stations, e.g. Port Gellhorn and Vice City
places.summary: Police pickups have an open bed crate you can loot with no alarm; cruiser trunks can hold assault rifles, shotguns or body armor. Where: Parked police cars (often at police stations in Port Gellhorn or Vice City) and police pickups seen in rural areas and the city.
how: Find an empty police pickup (e.g. Bravado Bison), climb on the bed and open the storage crate.
For a cruiser, slim jim the door, get in so the trunk unlocks, then open the trunk.
Stow the guns in your own car trunk to avoid drawing attention.
places.reward: Assault rifles, shotguns, ammo, stun guns, body armor
places.needs: Slim jim (Chapter 2 'Moses' mission) to avoid the cruiser alarm; without it the alarm goes off.

places.name: Mount Kalaga summit parachute + meteorite
places.summary: A free parachute waits at the top of the tallest peak, and a crashed meteorite sits about halfway up the trail. A mobility scooter at the summit is another way down. Where: On the trail and summit of the tallest peak in Mount Kalaga National Park, far north Leonida.
how: Climb the Mount Kalaga trail.
About halfway up, collect the crashed meteorite.
At the top (stone circle), take the parachute and glide down, which starts a parachuting minigame.

places.name: Hamlet teddy-bear warehouse (respawning loot exploit)
places.area: Outside Hamlet (Apollo Aggregates), South Vice-Dale County
places.summary: An abandoned drug front where cocaine in two teddy-bear vans and a safe respawns after you drive away. Not patched by update 1.002.002 (23 Nov 2026), per reports to 24 Nov. Where: A big warehouse (some call it a red barn) in an industrial area outside Hamlet, the town north of Key Lento; Notebookcheck puts it northeast of Hamlet.
how: Bring a van (10 bag slots; pest control vans are parked out front).
Collect cocaine from the two teddy-bear vans, the back-room tables and the safe; the safe also holds the Leroy Rook collectible card.
Drive about 0.3-0.5 miles away and come back; the vans and safe restock.
Store full bags in your car and at Brian's Lockup in south-west Key Lento (code 7700), then repeat.
Sell to the best narcotics fence you have (Tyrone in Chapter 3+).

Sources disagree: PC Gamer calls it a warehouse in Hamlet and repeats by driving away; Notebookcheck calls it a red barn northeast of Hamlet and repeats by save-and-reload. Game Rant places the Leroy Rook card building north of Key Lento, South Vice-Dale County.
places.reward: PC Gamer made over $50,000 from a half-full van; Notebookcheck cites up to $10,000 per run
places.needs: Exploit, may be patched later. No guards on site. Long drive to sell.

places.name: Kingpin Bowling Alley robbery
places.summary: Kolt-held bowling alley with a coded safe of about $3,400 and the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the pool table. Sticky bombs in the next room can blow the safe. Where: The Kingpin Bowling Alley, one of the Kolt & Associates robberies in Port Gellhorn.
how: Rob it during 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (Chapter 2), or earlier as Lucia.
Take the shotgun from the case on the pool table in the main room.
Open the safe with 0300, or use the sticky bombs found in the next room.
Sources disagree: GamesRadar+'s code list says 0330, but its own bowling guide and PC Gamer say 0300. PC Gamer spells the gun 'Gutterland'.
places.reward: About $3,400 safe cash, Gutterball Moreland 850, sticky bombs, drugs

places.name: Port Gellhorn stash house
places.summary: A small Kolt stash house with a no-code safe, cash in an air vent and, in one of two scenarios, the Kolt & Associates 556 rifle and drug bags. Where: A house in the residential area north of Port Gellhorn; the back door is unlocked.
how: Enter from the back yard through the unlocked back door.
Pry open the safe on the left before the kitchen (it holds the 6823 Boatworks code note).
Shoot the wall air vent and take the cash.
If gang members are present (scenario 2), take the rifle from the kitchen counter and drugs near the vent.
places.reward: Cash, Kolt & Associates 556 rifle (scenario 2 only), drug bags
places.needs: Police or gang presence depending on scenario.

places.name: Saber Shipping Facility
places.summary: A Guardia Brothers site with a unique SMG, a coded safe, a luxury watch and a board listing other Guardia safe codes. Where: In western Vice City on the southeastern edge of Balsero where it borders Rockridge, reachable by road or water.
how: Climb the containers left of the gate and drop over.
Take the yellow lift to the roof, go through the unlocked door and down the stairs.
Take the Guardia Brothers VF5 from the case at the bottom of the stairs.
Open the safe in the nearby room (1122 if closed) and take the B&G watch; note the board codes.
places.reward: Guardia Brothers VF5 SMG, safe loot, B&G Ark Royal Ashore watch, codes 8046 (Saber Shipping Yard) and 1965 (Casa Guardia)
places.needs: Appears after Raul's tip; exploring further starts a firefight.

places.name: Casa Guardia
places.summary: A Guardia hideout with a safe (code 1965, found at Saber Shipping), a luxury watch, jewelry, marked bills and the legendary Guardia Brothers FRA rifle. Where: In Little Cuba, north of Yasmani's Vape store and south of Rockridge.
how: Enter from the empty side lot and climb the ladder; knock out the roof guard.
Go down the ladder and grab table cash from the man stocking the safe, or open it with 1965.
Through the roof hatches, collect the watch, Zombix and a sticky bomb, then clear the ground floor.
Take the FRA rifle in the small room across the stairs and marked bills under the stairs; steal the Nightlight Schafter.
places.reward: Safe cash, jewelry, marked bills, Guardia Brothers FRA rifle, Nightlight Schafter (sells $8,500 in top condition)
places.needs: Armed guards; body armor is inside if needed.

places.name: Chatfield Storage & Logistics
places.area: Waxman Island, east of Vice City
places.summary: A dock robbery with about $9,000 in a coded safe, the Quarter Mile ES9 pistol and a supercar worth up to $30,000. Where: East of Vice City on Waxman Island, north of the Pay 'N' Spray.
how: Climb the fence without barbed wire near the Pay 'N' Spray.
Knock out the man behind the cargo on the left and read the laptop email at the open cargo (code 5800).
Open the safe in the building with stairs and take the Quarter Mile ES9.
Open the gate with the button by the security cabin and take the Progen Emerus from an open container.
places.reward: About $9,000 safe cash, Quarter Mile ES9 pistol, Progen Purple Drank Emerus (sells $30,000 to Randy)
places.needs: Randy's shop opens in Chapter 3; sticky bomb is an alternative to the code.

places.name: Iron Building Supply (Final Chapter hideout)
places.summary: A biker warehouse with a no-code safe, drug packages and the unique KVGA-12 semi-auto shotgun. Where: A warehouse near the railways in western Ambrosia, held by the Final Chapter biker gang.
how: Climb the ladder by the left gate to the roof and drop through the broken skylight.
Break open the safe in the second-floor office.
Collect drug packages in the ground-floor corridor and the KVGA-12 on the corner cabin wall.
Loot the van trunks in the back yard and flip a gate switch to escape (no getaway car).
places.reward: Safe cash, drug packages, Final Chapter KVGA-12 shotgun
places.needs: Bikers on guard; exit gates start closed.

places.name: Biker Hideout bar
places.summary: Safe code 1982 (on the black flag), the Ride Free H&L .38 revolver and a unique LCC Monarch Avarus bike. Where: A Final Chapter biker bar east of Ambrosia; the loot room is behind the pool table.
how: Enter the bar and force the door behind the pool table; fight the bikers.
Take drug packages, open the safe by the exit door with 1982, and grab the revolver under the black flag.
In the back yard corner, take the bike and the helmet on the workbench.
places.reward: Safe cash, Ride Free H&L .38, LCC Monarch Avarus bike, drugs
places.needs: Robbing another Final Chapter hideout first can trigger an ambush here.

places.name: Carter Mining Boathouse
places.area: Northern Lummox County, northeast of Bonanza
places.summary: A small robbery with a safe and cocaine; the safe code may differ per player. Where: A boathouse northeast of Bonanza in northern Lummox County, with vehicles parked outside.
how: Park on the main road and walk in (back entrance available); wear a mask.
Open the safe on the left (the guide's code was 2416; otherwise read the green note on the wooden table).
Collect the cocaine and leave by car or boat.
places.needs: A few guards; silenced pistol helps.

places.name: Nova Auto Junkyard
places.summary: A junkyard robbery with a fixed safe code (7777, the lowrider's plate in the junkyard garage) and the unique Marabunta Grande KZ-59 rifle. Where: The Nova Auto Junkyard illegal operation in Hamlet.
how: Start the Nova Auto Junkyard illegal operation in Hamlet.
Read the lowrider's license plate in the garage, or use 7777, to open the safe.
Loot the Marabunta Grande KZ-59.

places.name: Big bank vaults (8)
places.summary: Vaults can only be opened by an armored-car guard; follow a security van in and rob the bank once he is at the vault. Can pay $100,000 or more. Where: Eight large banks: four in Ocean Beach, two Downtown, one in Tequesta and one at Vice City International Airport.
how: Do every Yasmani job; in Chapter 4 pay his $10,000 tip to see two security vans (pink icons), or spot one yourself.
Follow the van to a bank and wait until the guard is deep inside at the vault.
Start the robbery, get through the back door (snap gun or explosives), subdue the guard and empty the cart and deposit boxes.
Sticky-bomb the van's rear door before going in so it doesn't despawn.
places.reward: $100,000+ per vault in bills and valuables
places.needs: Chapter 4; alarm = instant 4-star wanted level; bring both characters for 4 bags.

places.name: BURG Facilities #2-#5 meteorites
places.area: Underwater: Little Hardin Island, Wild Hog Point, Mile Zero, Key Lento
places.summary: Each facility has one meteorite inside (on a counter or table). #3 and #5 are very deep. Where: Four more underwater BURG facilities: #2 east of Little Hardin Island, #3 west of Wild Hog Point, #4 north of Mile Zero Air Station, #5 east of Key Lento near Kenton's shop.
how: Dive to each facility (scuba gear needed for #3 and #5).
Pick up the meteorite inside.
Sell meteorites (Push Square says to Kenton).
Sources disagree: Push Square says sell BURG meteorites to Kenton; Game Rant says meteorites sell at pawn shops.

places.name: Key Lento collectible cards and luxury watch
places.summary: Early cards and a luxury watch you can sell. Cards come in 18 sets and sell at pawn shops; sold cards still count for 100%. Where: Several fixed spots in Key Lento: The Rusty Anchor, a party house on Dolphin Dr, the Badger R&D Tower off Sunset Dr, and Steven Stachan Construction across Sunbelt Hwy.
how: The Rusty Anchor: 'Aimie' card in the Captain's Log Room toilet stall.
Dolphin Dr party house: Novak Laurent Alcazar watch on the bedroom table upstairs; Lionel Taber card in the toilet.
Top of Badger R&D Tower: 'Thelma' card. Steven Stachan Construction (enter from the back): 'Georgia' card by a green box.
places.reward: Sellable cards and a luxury watch

places.name: Starlet Motel
places.summary: Chapter 2 home base. It is lost for good when you start 'Checking Out'. Where: The Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn, the safehouse from the end of Chapter 1 through Chapter 2.
how: Arrives with the story at the end of Chapter 1.

places.name: Boobie's apartment, Bayside
places.summary: Chapter 3 safehouse unlocked in 'Welcome to Vice City'. Later safehouses are the Y Hotel (Chapter 4) and Pegassi Tower (Chapter 5). Where: Boobie Ike's apartment in Bayside, Vice City, from the start of Chapter 3.
how: Unlocks with the story at the start of Chapter 3.

places.name: Buyable garages (8)
places.area: Kelly County, Belville, VCIA, Ambrosia, Capri, Vice Beach, Ocean Beach
places.summary: Garages are the only property you can buy. Prices run $4,000 to $40,000; later you can leave loot in a garage for fence pickup. Where: Eight garages sold in the Vice City Real Estate app, from Mitchell Auto Center in Kelly County to Atlantic Court Garage in Ocean Beach.
how: Finish 'Daily Driver' (Chapter 2) to open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy e.g. Mitchell Auto Center ($4,000), Persistence Road Garage, Belville ($7,600), Store n' Bolt, northern Ambrosia ($16,800), Atlantic Court, Ocean Beach ($40,000).
places.reward: Vehicle storage; garage loot pickup after two Payday Loan jobs for Yasmani

places.name: Brian's Lockup and Donnie's trailer (fences)
places.summary: The first two fences, Chapter 1 only. Both pay low; Donnie pays slightly more for narcotics but goes away before 'Swamped'. Where: Brian's Lockup in south Key Lento and Donnie's drop box at his trailer in Key Lento.
how: Unlock Brian in 'Lab Fees' and Donnie in 'Clean Up After Donnie'.
Leave goods in the drop box; money arrives later in your mailbox.
places.reward: Cash for narcotics, jewelry and marked bills

places.name: Dunk's trailer (fence)
places.summary: Fence for narcotics, jewelry and marked bills from Chapter 2 on; low pay but stays open all game. Where: Dunk's trailer near the centre of Port Gellhorn; drop box in his car trunk.
how: Unlock after 'Slam Dunk' (Chapter 2).
Drop goods in his car trunk.

places.name: Tyrone (narcotics fence)
places.summary: Pays the most for narcotics (even more after the Kitty Litter labs); medium for jewelry and bills. Pays on the spot. Where: Tyrone's apartment in La Perle, Vice City.
how: Unlock in 'Here, Kitty Kitty' (Chapter 3).
Sell at his apartment.

places.name: Yasmani (jewelry and bills fence)
places.summary: Pays high for jewelry and marked bills; gives jewelry jobs, the snap gun and later the $10,000 security-van tip for bank vaults. Where: Yasmani's shop in Little Cuba, Vice City.
how: Unlock in 'Boobie Time' (Chapter 3).
Sell at his shop; do his jobs for tips.

places.name: Randy (high-end car fence)
places.summary: Chapter 3 car fence for flashy cars, takes advanced trackers and pays far more than Moses, e.g. $30,000 for a top-condition Emerus. Where: Randy's shop in Balsero on the outskirts of Vice City.
how: Unlock in 'Steal The Zorrusso for Randy' (Chapter 3).
Bring cars from his wish list for the best payouts.

places.name: Pay 'n' Spray shops
places.area: Across Leonida, e.g. Salton, Balsero, Waxman Island
places.summary: Repair, respray to drop vehicle heat, and later sell cars (including stored ones). Daily sale limit is lower than Moses or Randy. Where: Shops across Leonida, including Pay 'N' Spray - Salton and Pay 'N' Spray - Balsero in Vice City and one on Waxman Island.
how: Unlock in 'Just a Scratch' (Chapter 1); selling opens after Moses vouches for you.
Use Index > Vehicles > Pay 'n' Sprays to list the nearest ones.
places.reward: Repairs, resprays, car sales to BuckMe

places.name: UFO abduction
places.area: Kelly County (near the Starlet Motel, east of Port Gellhorn)
places.summary: A random night-time encounter: follow a trail of clothes from an abandoned car to a woman floating in a UFO's beam. Helping her ends with you being abducted and waking up days later. It is part one of the alien questline. Where: On quiet dirt roads north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, look for an abandoned car with its doors open and lights flashing.
how: Reach Chapter 2, then go alone (not with both Jason and Lucia).
Drive dark roads NW of the Starlet Motel / east of Port Gellhorn at night; the car spawns randomly, so retry other nights.
Follow the clothes to the light, talk to the woman, then go to fetch her car; the UFO takes you.

Sources disagree: Dexerto says 'after 2 PM'; Red Bull says around 2am and other guides say after 2 AM, so 2 PM is likely a typo. VGC says the car can appear in many places, not one fixed spot. VGC gives the trophy at the end of the questline, Red Bull at the abduction.
places.reward: Starts the alien questline; Red Bull says the abduction gives 'The Truth Is Out There' trophy.
places.needs: Chapter 2+, night, alone. Spawn is not guaranteed.

places.name: Alien rescue: the place in the orb
places.area: Pelican Valley swamp, south of Hamlet (per VGC)
places.summary: After the abduction, sleeping triggers an alien-ship dream with a keypad and light puzzle. The same building exists in Leonida; break in, repeat the puzzle, carry 'milk' to the machine and free a captive alien that the UFO then beams up.
how: Where: a fenced, angular compound with a large tower in the swamp south of Hamlet in Pelican Valley, just west of the main road north from Key Lento over the Shoreless Keys.
After the abduction, sleep as the abducted character to get the dream; note the code drawn as lines above the keypad.
Drive a truck or van onto the metal structure at the rear of the compound to clear the barbed fence.
Enter the dream code, take the lift down, solve the four-light puzzle, carry the milk from the left room to the machine on the right.
Carry the alien to the surface; the UFO takes it and helps you escape the police.

Sources disagree: VGC puts the base in Pelican Valley swamp south of Hamlet, Dexerto says Mariana County, Red Bull says southern Leonida. Door code: 2314 (Dexerto, Red Bull) or 2431 (VGC, who says it may vary per playthrough).
Puzzle colour: VGC says turn the lights blue, Dexerto says green.
places.reward: Permanent Health, Stamina and Focus buffs for both Jason and Lucia (VGC); Dexerto says a health, stamina and focus buff.
places.needs: UFO abduction completed. Large vehicle helps to get over the fence.

places.name: UFO house rooftop sighting
places.area: West Ambrosia, near the liquor store
places.summary: Climb onto the roof after 2 AM and sit in the chair; nearby lights die and a UFO flies past. A French bulldog in an alien onesie wanders the yard. Where: A house on the west side of Ambrosia near the liquor store, with a home-made space shuttle on the roof and a UFO drawing in the garden.
how: Go after 2 AM.
Use the ladder at the back of the house to reach the roof.
Sit in the rooftop chair and wait a few seconds.
places.reward: Dexerto says the first encounter unlocks 'The Truth Is Out There'; no other reward.

places.name: Skunk Ape: swamp encounter
places.area: Grassrivers swamp, around Cottonmouth Lake / Gullet Marsh (Mariana County)
places.summary: Listen for growls in the swamp, track the creature with Focus to a dead deer and then to a wooden effigy on a tree. Inspecting the flowers and spores knocks Jason out. Where: In the swamp south-east of Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet, in Mariana County.
how: From Chapter 1, drive the swamp roads near Cottonmouth Lake and listen for growling.
Use Focus Mode (L3+R3) to track it, follow to the deer carcass, then to the tree effigy.
Inspect the flowers and spores by the carving to trigger the cutscene.

Sources disagree: Red Bull names Gullet Marsh; Dexerto says south-east of Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet. Other guides describe the spot differently, so it may be the same swamp described two ways.
places.reward: A cutscene; Red Bull says a Weazel News report on sightings then plays on the TV at Jason's house.

places.name: Kirk's Skunk Ape hunts
places.area: Pelican River / Pelican Valley, Mariana County
places.summary: A Strangers & Freaks chain: search for the Skunk Ape, inspect three of nine tree effigies in Pelican Valley, then help Kirk find 'Mr. Mangrove'. The ending depends on whom you shoot. Where: Flyers at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet or the Rusty Anchor in north Key Lento; Kirk meets you near Pelican River at night.
how: Read the 'Have You Seen Skunk Ape???' flyer to add Kirk, then call him.
Meet him near Pelican River at night for Search for the Skunk Ape.
After his text, inspect three tree effigies in Pelican Valley (an airboat helps).
In Chapter 2, as Lucia at night, do Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
places.reward: $1,000; Mister Mangrove Laird 350 tranquilliser rifle; up to $10,000 if you shoot Mr. Mangrove.
places.needs: Chapter 1 for the first two parts; final part Chapter 2, Lucia, night.

places.name: The literal Easter egg nest
places.area: Bluegrass, southern Vice-Dale County (north of Hamlet)
places.summary: Climb the tower's ladders (about 5-8 minutes) to find a bird's nest of coloured eggs. Throw one off the platform and a hidden cutscene plays as it lands. Where: At the very top of the big red-and-white communications tower in Bluegrass, just north of Hamlet.
how: Hop the fence at the tower base and find the ladder.
Climb to the highest platform; the nest is on your right.
Pick up one egg and throw it over the edge (Red Bull: with the throw gauge fully charged).
Sources disagree: Red Bull calls it the tallest radio tower in Vice City; Dexerto places it in Bluegrass north of Hamlet.
places.needs: Nothing but patience for the climb.

places.name: Vice City 1986 portal (Malibu Club)
places.area: Badger R&D Radio Tower (Key Lento), then LPL Turtle Head Power Station
places.summary: Switch on a TV in the Key Lento tower, then flip the right lever at 12 LPL substations in order (the letters spell the old Vice City cheat 'Life is Passing Me By'). A text sends you to Reactor 2 at night, where a portal opens into the 2002 Malibu Club and Kent Paul.
how: Where: it starts in the room near the top of the Badger R&D radio tower in Key Lento and ends at Reactor 2 of the LPL Turtle Head Power Station, on an island east of Hamlet.
In the Badger R&D tower, turn the power box on and press the switchboard button until 'Malibu' shows.

Visit the 12 substations in order (Downtown, Balsero, Key Lento, Penmarch Isle, Crosstown, Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, Gloriana Key, Hamlet, Gellhorn Raceway, Hamlet, North Mariana) pressing D,D,.,A,.,A,A,A,.,W,D,W.
No fast travel, auto-drive, deaths or arrests, or it resets.
After the 'Unknown' text, enter Turtle Head Power Station between 7 PM and 6 AM and flip the lever left of Reactor 2's door.
Sources disagree: Bike name: VGC says Malibu Zombie Bobber; Dexerto says Biker Angel. VGC is unsure Lucia works; Pure Xbox says she does. Some players report the portal not appearing.
places.reward: Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt plus a retro motorbike.
places.needs: A helicopter helps between substations. Single protagonist; Jason confirmed.

places.name: Super Mario block and hats
places.summary: Smoke the bong on the table in the middle of the ruin and a near-invisible block appears at the top of the building. Shoot it to drop two Mario-style caps. Where: A dilapidated ruined building in the lower (southern) part of Moreau, Lummox County.
how: Find the bong next to a yellow box of cash in the middle of the building.
Smoke it.
Climb to the block that appears at the top and shoot it gently so the hats don't fly too far.
places.reward: A purple 'J' cap and a teal 'L' cap; both characters can collect them.
places.needs: If both characters climb together they can knock each other off.

places.name: Haunted lighthouse and ghost ship
places.area: St. Lucia lighthouse, Little Hardin Island, Leonard County
places.summary: At night two ghost keepers argue at the lighthouse light. A book in the nearby house leads you to dive for a sunken boat at 1:30 AM, then watch a ghost ship from the top of the lighthouse before dawn. Where: The St. Lucia lighthouse on Little Hardin Island in Leonard County, with a house north-west of it and a boat on the island's east point.
how: At night, watch the two ghosts with binoculars, then climb the lighthouse.
Break into the house NW of the lighthouse and read the blue book by the fireplace.
At 1:30 AM take the dock boat with scuba gear to the east point; when fog rolls in, dive to the wreck and take the knife.
Climb back up the lighthouse before daybreak to see the ghost ship.
places.needs: Night; scuba gear (on the boat). A metal detector helps underwater.

places.name: Giant crab research outpost
places.summary: Restore power, read the password scratched into the floor, and log into the researcher's computer. Logging out triggers an ambush by an unkillable giant crab; then open the safe and boathouse. Where: An abandoned research outpost in Gullet Marsh, south-west of Pelican Valley and just north of the Leonida Keys; a fracking tower nearby is the landmark.
how: Turn on the breaker box outside the main building.
Read the floorboard carving in the side room: password CLEAVES.
Log in, read the journal, log out and survive the crab with button prompts.
Safe code 0072; boathouse keypad 0212.
Sources disagree: Dexerto's page itself is inconsistent on whether the safe holds cash or a jet ski.
places.reward: Crabshack VF5 SMG in the boathouse, a jet ski, and cash (GTA Culture says about $10,000).

places.name: Hyde Island manhunt
places.area: Hyde Island (north of Lummox County / Moreau River mouth)
places.summary: Walk the island alone and a tranquilliser dart knocks you out. You wake in a container with an explosive collar and must kill an armoured hunter, Manhunt/Saw-style, then escape via the boathouse. Where: A C-shaped island off the north coast, north of Lummox County at the Moreau River; no bridges, so arrive by boat, helicopter or swimming.
how: Go alone as Jason or Lucia and walk around the island until darted.
When the container opens, take cover and grab the lit weapon stashes (a shotgun is best).
Kill the hunter, then reach the boathouse to get your gear back.
Sources disagree: gta6.house also reports a second trigger (helping a woman load a sofa in Grayson, or Vice City); Dexerto does not mention it. Cash amounts vary by source.
places.reward: Island Poacher FF-50 camo sniper rifle and $20,000-$30,000.
places.needs: A boat or aircraft; be alone.

places.name: Immortal Man
places.area: Southern Key Lento, near Donnie's Caravan
places.summary: Scope the house decks with a sniper rifle and a man in a light blue shirt and white shorts looks straight at you, makes a throat-slit gesture and starts hunting you. He seems immune to damage. Where: On a house deck near Donnie's Caravan in southern Key Lento, seen from the nearby tower.
how: Go to Donnie's Caravan and climb the nearby tower over the houses.
Scan the decks with a sniper scope for the man in light blue.
Be ready: he follows you once seen.
Sources disagree: Dexerto notes players have reported him elsewhere too, and it is unconfirmed if he can be killed.

places.name: Kraken shipwreck
places.area: Open water south-east of Gloriana Key
places.summary: Dive to a large sunken ship that has giant Kraken tentacles wrapped around it. It cannot be seen from the surface. Where: On the seabed south-east of Gloriana Key, off Leonida's south coast; not marked on the map.
how: Take a boat south-east from Gloriana Key into open water.
Put on scuba gear and dive to the seabed to find the big wreck.
Watch for sharks.
Sources disagree: Dexerto puts Gloriana Key in the Leonida Keys; VGC's retro-portal guide lists Gloriana Key under Vice City.

places.name: Marbelle Hotel (Silent Hill)
places.summary: Enter through the back: mannequins face the walls and doors open by themselves. At the roof stairs the lights die, red symbols and whispers appear, and Vice City is covered in fog until you open the ground-floor safe. Where: The Marbelle Hotel on NW 8th Street in southern Crosstown, near the Nine1Nine nightclub, just off the interstate.
how: Go round the building and use the back door.
Climb to the rooftop stairs and walk through the self-opening door.
After the sequence, take the Old Note on the roof: safe code 955214.
Open the ground-floor safe to lift the fog.
places.reward: Cash and a watch from the safe; a comic card on a cabinet. Dexerto says the safe can also pop 'The Truth Is Out There'.
places.needs: None. If the roof door stays locked, go down and climb again.

places.name: The Merman
places.area: Shoreless Keys, north-west of Key Lento
places.summary: A man in a sparkly mermaid tail poses for a camera on a tripod. You can spray water on his tail for him, or ruin his shoot and he turns aggressive. Where: A small, isolated beach on a secluded island in the Shoreless Keys, north-west of Key Lento.
how: Take a boat or jet ski north-west from Key Lento through the islands.
Search small beaches for the tripod and the man in the tail.

places.name: Mushroom 'Mind Maze' trip
places.area: Lake Tallaloko, north of Millport (Lummox County)
places.summary: Eat the '???' item on the container workbench to start a trippy container maze. Pull the lever, cross the hanging logs and climbing rooms, then swim the flooded tunnel to finish. Where: In an open orange shipping container at the construction site on the south-east shore of Lake Tallaloko, just north of Millport.
how: Pick your character first; whoever eats it gets the reward.
Eat the '???' item, pull the lever at the dead end, then follow the pink and red hallways.
Climb the big room, squeeze through the blue-lit hole, head for the exit sign and swim down the tunnel to the red/green light.
places.reward: Permanent max Stamina increase and the 'Mind Maze Left Leg Award' tattoo design.

places.name: Pennywise balloon elevator
places.summary: The left lift has a red balloon on it. Call the right lift: it arrives full of balloons, the lights go out and a killer clown briefly appears. Where: The elevators to the left of reception inside the Haymarket building in Ocean Beach.
how: Enter the Haymarket building and go left from reception to the lifts.
Check for the red balloon on the left lift.
Call the right lift, step in and close the doors.

places.name: Pet Cemetery and the ghost cat
places.area: Southern Grayson, Lummox County (woods by SR-73)
places.summary: Spot a black ghost cat in two Grayson spots and it opens a locked building with a tattoo magazine, then leads you to the pet cemetery. Scan the altar, then return at night to light the last candle. Where: A hidden pet graveyard in the woods of southern Grayson near State Road 73; the ghost cat shows up by the bait shop, bike shop and Pay 'N' Spray in Grayson.
how: Find the cat in two of: in front of the bait shop, near the bike shop, in front of the Pay 'N' Spray.
Enter the now-open building NE of the bait shop and WAiNK the magazine under the table.
Follow the cat to the cemetery and WAiNK the altar/gravestones; come back at night and light the final candle.
places.reward: Zombie Deer tattoo (Jason) and the Pet Cemetery Curiosity entry.
places.needs: Sleep and return if the cat won't appear.

places.name: Satan's party house
places.summary: When the garage glows red and plays metal, two metalheads take you to a woodland camp; stare into the fire and wake in Hell to fight demons and then Satan himself. Where: A corner house on Gellhorn Avenue by Draper Bay in northern Port Gellhorn, just north of the Kolt & Associates stash house, painted 'Welcome to the Hell hole'.
how: Chapter 2+, alone, between midnight and 4 AM; leave and return if the garage is shut.
Talk to Beelzebub and Dave and say 'It's Good' about their music; ride in their van.
At the camp look into the fire, fight to Satan's arena, and only shoot once his health bar turns red.
places.reward: Permanent max Health boost, a tattoo design, Circles of Hell top, Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun.

places.name: Scarface motel scene
places.summary: Arrive at midday, try the first upstairs room door and walk round; a scene plays out, after which you can grab a silenced SMG matching the one from the film. Where: The Sunlite Motel on Shore Drive in Ocean Beach.
how: Go between 12 PM and 1 PM.
Try the first upstairs room, walk the balcony, go down and back to the front.
Watch the scene, then return to the room for the gun.
places.reward: Little Friend W-10 silenced SMG, plus cash and drugs in the room.

places.name: Self-aware NPC house (San Andreas photo)
places.summary: The house from a mystery photo hidden in GTA San Andreas Definitive Edition. Break into the garage to find a conspiracy wall by a man convinced he lives in a video game (identical people, vanishing cars, invisible borders). Where: A suburban house in Belville with a white picket fence and two palm trees; the clue wall is in the garage.
how: Search Belville's streets for the picket-fence house with two palms.
Break in through the garage door and examine the board.

places.name: Pineapple house (SpongeBob)
places.summary: A roadside pineapple house you can walk inside, a nod to SpongeBob. No interactions. Where: A walk-in pineapple-shaped building by the road on Cicada Avenue near Bluegrass, marked by a bus stop sign.
how: Drive Cicada Avenue near Bluegrass and look for the bus stop by the pineapple.

places.name: Ninja Turtles and Splinter
places.area: North of Millport (water treatment / Tallaloko Dam channel)
places.summary: At night four turtles and a rat sit by pizza boxes. Watch them through binoculars; get too close and the rat runs off. Where: A water treatment facility (GTA Culture: the Tallaloko Dam channel past the pump house) north of Millport.
how: Go at night (daytime shows only pizza boxes).
Use binoculars from a distance.
WAiNK the oozing crack in the wall.
Sources disagree: Dexerto says Millport is in Leonard County; Dexerto's mushroom page puts Lake Tallaloko north of Millport in Lummox County.
places.reward: 'Intriguing Substance' Curiosity, Ratster collectible card, animal log entries.

places.name: Dexter's apartment and kill kit
places.area: Trinity Apartments, Washington Island, Vice City
places.summary: Dexter Morgan's locked corner flat on the second floor, a kill kit on the roof and his fishing boat at the jetty. Where: A light-blue building with a spiral staircase between the Pay 'N' Spray and Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons on Washington Island; his boat is at the docks to the west.
how: Go to the second floor and walk west to the last corner flat.
Climb the side ladder to the roof for the kit and an orange toolbox.
Walk to the docks west of the building for the Lure Predator L35P boat.
places.reward: A knife and $68 from the toolbox; drivable boat.

places.name: Dexter kill room garage
places.summary: Break into the road-facing garage to find a plastic-wrapped kill room with a table and tools. Where: A beach house on Surfside Drive near the Crastenburg Hotel, about 1 km south-west of Jason's house.
how: Find the beach house with the garage facing the road.
Choose Break In at the garage door.

places.name: Arthur Morgan's hat
places.summary: A Red Dead Redemption 2 nod: buy a cowboy hat matching Arthur Morgan's at a yard sale. Where: A yard sale at a blue house with a US flag at the south end of Port Gellhorn; the hat sits on a guitar case by the couch.
how: Reach Chapter 2 (the yard is empty before then).
Go to the couch at the back of the yard and buy the hat on the guitar case.
Sources disagree: Dexerto and GTA Culture say $35; Red Bull says $5 and lists it under a flea market.
places.reward: Genuine Cowboy Hat, wearable by both.

places.name: Christine (Stephen King car)
places.summary: Open the garage to find a red 1958 Plymouth Fury-style car with red headlights and plate 'P05 ESD'. Where: In the small garage across from a farmhouse in North Leonard County.
how: Find the farmhouse in North Leonard County.
Open the small garage opposite it.

places.name: #NoFlushers and Dr. Merle
places.area: Corsair Key (start), Tequesta (Vice City), sewage plant in Hamlet
places.summary: A conspiracy side story: join the No Flushers by text, meet Dr. Merle at night, sneak him into the sewage plant, solve a panel and flush him, then enter the chamber yourself. Where: Scan a 'Stop! Don't Flush' QR poster (best: public restroom on Corsair Key NE of Key Lento), meet Dr. Merle at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta, end at the Hamlet sewage plant.
how: Scan the QR with WAiNK (also at Nine1Nine, Dynamix Fitness, a Port Gellhorn notice board); reply TRUTH; keep code 00-00-02.
Meet Merle at Frank's Waffles at night and give the code; drive his van to the Hamlet plant.
Use Defuse, then Lie (electricians); set middle and bottom lights green and pull the lever; flush Merle, then step in.
places.needs: WAiNK app; night for the meeting.

places.name: Dom Toretto's car
places.summary: Break open the garage to find a Fast & Furious-style muscle car you can steal and register. Where: In the garage of a house with a supercar in the driveway on the west side of Capri.
how: Find the house with a supercar in the drive in west Capri.
Break the garage door, then Slim Jim or smash in.
Register it at a workshop.

places.name: Painted tunnel (Looney Tunes)
places.summary: A Road Runner-style mural of a road running under a bridge that looks like a real tunnel. It is a solid wall. Where: About 160 m south-east of the Fufu clothing store toward the gas station.
how: From Fufu, head about 160 m south-east and look for the mural.
places.reward: None; you crash if you drive in.

places.name: Kyle McKittrick (red Hulk)
places.summary: A crop-duster pilot's Strangers & Freaks chain ends with Kyle mutated into a red Hulk-like creature in his barn with police outside. Where: Flyer outside the Starlet Motel reception; the farm is in Frogswater, NE of the Starlet Motel and east of Port Gellhorn.
how: Chapter 2: read the 'Pilot Wanted' flyer at the Starlet Motel and meet Kyle at the airstrip.
Do Check Out McKittrick Farm, then Collect Chemicals for Kyle.
Chapter 3: Buddy? - go to the barn.
places.reward: Kill Kyle: $5,000. Spare him: an optional hug (no pay, and it hurts).

places.name: Michael's boat from GTA V
places.summary: The boat resembles Michael De Santa's yacht; its chartplotter shows a street grid that looks like Los Santos. Where: The old sailboat in the yard of Jason's house in Key Lento.
how: Climb the ladder at the stern.
Zoom in on the helm screen with the phone camera.
Sources disagree: GTA Culture notes Rockstar has not confirmed it is Michael's boat.
A fan guide (RetroBroker) describes it as a GTA V-style yacht moored beside the house.
places.needs: Do it in Chapter 1 while you can still use the house.

places.name: President Russo's bunkers
places.area: Downtown, Little Cuba, Sharktooth Island and more (see How)
places.summary: A Cold War chain of codes: a veteran's tape and photo lead to the president's island bunker, its safe gives a pistol and a photo whose 'OBSESS' note is the next hatch code, opening the IAA Black Site with a tank.
how: Where: it starts at the Friends of Freedom memorial on Catalan Blvd in Downtown Vice City, then a flat on NW 4th Ave in Little Cuba, a bunker on Sharktooth Island, and a hatch south of the Ammu-Nation in North Mariana County.
Talk to veteran Jose Bermudez at the memorial; visit his Little Cuba flat for the tape and photo.
Sharktooth Island door: 010317. Use the desk phone, then safe code 2975.
Hatch (keypad on a tree) south of the North Mariana Ammu-Nation: 085355. Turn on power at the far left.
Sources disagree: GTA Culture says the hatch is near Tola Bay; Game Rant says south of the Ammu-Nation in southern North Mariana County.
places.reward: Russo's 1922 Pistol, Cold War 556 Assault Rifle, Hauners Ridgway tank; unlocks a Russo assassination side mission.

places.name: Frampton Islands bunker
places.summary: A keypad bunker with a tunnel labelled 'Water Analysis and Testing' and a body inside; a fan theory ties it to clones. Where: On a hill on the Frampton Islands in the north-east of East Lummox County, reached by boat.
how: Boat to the Frampton Islands and walk up the hill.
Enter keypad code 3612.
Sources disagree: The clone theory is unverified.

places.name: La Llorona ghost lady
places.area: Lummox County, road north of Killtelligence Provisions
places.summary: Drive slowly here alone at night and your car fails as a woman crawls on all fours across the road. After she vanishes, call out and her cry comes from your car radio; the car is now haunted. Where: On the road directly north of Bret's Killtelligence Provisions marker in Lummox County.
how: Send your partner home (Split Up).
Drive the road slowly between 1 AM and 4 AM.
After the cutscene, get out, use Call Out, then get back in.

places.name: Ghostbusters car
places.summary: An Ecto-1 style wagon parked outside a Halloween house; doors unlocked. Where: In front of a Halloween-decorated house in a residential block south-east of Capri.
how: Chapter 2, after unlocking Moses' mod shop.
Drive to the Halloween house SE of Capri and get in.
places.reward: Declasse Ghost Exposed Parkland and the Ghost Exposed livery at Vinyl Vice.

places.name: Freddie's doomsday compound (hurricanes)
places.area: North shore of Lake Leonida, North Leonard County
places.summary: Break into prepper Freddie's compound once unprompted; later he texts for a rematch with tougher mines and drones. Inside, a hurricane hits, and that unlocks hurricane weather for the rest of the save. Where: A big compound ringed by electric fences and end-of-the-world billboards on the north shore of Lake Leonida.
how: First visit: climb the water tower outside the fence and jump to a shed roof; walk on pipes/cables to avoid mines.
Second visit: in the NW corner, park the tractor trailer by the fence and lift it with the bulldozer as a ramp.
Reach the bunker door; choose to stay or leave when the storm alert sounds.
Sources disagree: Other guides describe the first-visit entry as moving a shipping container with a loader, and give different cash amounts ($5,000-$10,000).
places.reward: Leave: $6,250. Stay: Benefactor Dubsta. Unlocks hurricane weather.
places.needs: Any chapter; no marker on the first visit.

places.name: Stone Hills fire tower shed (69185)
places.area: Mount Kalaga National Park, Lummox County
places.summary: A sticky note in the tower cabin reads 'Shed: 69185'. The shed holds alien stickers and a logbook that turns into conspiracy drawings of a strange figure; fans link it to the unsolved 'Gliding Man' logbooks. Where: The keypad shed at the foot of the Stone Hills firewatch tower in Mount Kalaga National Park.
how: Climb the Stone Hills tower and read the note in the top cabin.
Enter 69185 on the shed keypad below.
Read the logbook on the table.
Sources disagree: Some guides call it a bunker and one listed the code as 691865.

places.name: Monument of Leonidan Supremacy
places.summary: A Georgia Guidestones-style pillar with a gold globe and four symbol-marked stallions. Players report the controller vibrating and beeping in a possible Morse pattern nearby. Unsolved. Where: Near Manifest Canyon in Kelly County.
how: Drive to the monument near Manifest Canyon and approach it.
Feel for controller vibration and listen for beeps.
Sources disagree: Red Bull also ties it to stone circles at the summit of Mount Kalaga. The beeping is from one Reddit report.

places.name: Crashed paraglider pistol
places.area: Bobcat Bight, west coast of Mariana County
places.summary: A crashed powered paraglider is stuck in a tree, easy to walk past. Its seat holds a free unique pistol. Where: Hanging in the shore pines on the Bobcat Bight peninsula, south of Belpoint across Tola Bay from North Mariana.
how: Set a waypoint on the sandy tip of Bobcat Bight.
Walk the treeline by the water and look up for the wreck.
Take the pistol from the seat (shoot the cords if it is too high).
Sources disagree: Spelled 'Bobcat Blight' on some sites.

places.name: The Sniper of La Perle mixtape
places.area: Crosstown and La Perle, Vice City
places.summary: Scan four flyers around Crosstown and La Perle to unlock a 40-minute Kodak Black mixtape in the On Demand menu. Where: Four posters: Jack of Hearts (Mirimar Dr, Crosstown), Aunt Zola's (NW 11th St, La Perle), Twa Ponya Tattoo and Drip Drops (both Del Rio Blvd, La Perle).
how: Jack of Hearts: upstairs studio corridor, first door left, poster on the flightcase.
Aunt Zola's: pinboard left of the entrance.
Twa Ponya Tattoo: table right of the door. Drip Drops: counter behind the clerk's monitor.
places.reward: The Sniper of La Perle mixtape (hold Left > On Demand).

places.name: Key Lento stunt jumps
places.summary: The three easiest early jumps of the 130 in the game. Stunt jumps count toward 250 stunts for the Cunning Stunts trophy and 300 for 100%. Where: Schlott Construction Key Lento (south-east of the Christmas House near Laguna Ln) and the Key Lento Bridge East and West jumps on the bridge beside Sunbelt Hwy.
how: Hit each ramp at speed; finishing the jump counts even if you miss the optional challenge.
Track them under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots > Stunt Jumps.
places.reward: Stunt progress; 50 jumps unlock the Unlimited Nitrous cheat (per cheat guides).
