places.name: Pink car at Janjak's Garage (robbery)
places.area: Janjak's Garage, southwest of La Perle, Vice-Dale County
places.summary: A pink car is one of three loot items at the San4San Janjak's Garage robbery. Game Rant does not name the model. Where: Inside Janjak's Garage, a robbery site southwest of the La Perle district.
how: Climb the tyre pile by the main door and over the blue sunshade to the roof.
Take the rifle by the open hatch and clear the guards from above.
Loot the safe, then drive the pink car out before police arrive.
places.reward: Pink car (model not named) plus other robbery loot.

places.name: The Vault radio station (poster)
places.summary: Scan one red poster inside the club with the WAiNK app to unlock DJ Pretzel's house and techno station. Where: Inside The Vault nightclub on 7th Street in north-west Downtown Vice City, across from Nine1Nine; the red gas-mask poster is near the top of the stairs.
how: Enter the club and go up the stairs.
Hold Up and press R1/RB to WAiNK the red gas-mask poster.
Tune in by holding Left and choosing The Vault.
Sources disagree: Push Square gives NW 7th St; gta6.house gives NE 7th Street.

places.name: Avery Pawn robbery
places.summary: Optional Chapter 2 job 'Hit Avery Pawn', one of four that appear after 'Coffee Break'. Cash and jewellery count toward the $15,000 needed to reach Vice City. The safe code is random and you get it from a clerk. Where: In the Crossroad Park strip mall in Port Gellhorn, next to Happy Nails, with parking beside Uncle Jack's Liquor.
how: After 'Coffee Break', start 'Hit Avery Pawn' from the map (Jason or Lucia).
Wear a mask, draw your gun and threaten a clerk behind the counter until 'Safe Code?' appears; don't kill or knock them out first.
Go behind the counter, through the staff door and back room to the office; open the safe by the desk, wipe CCTV and turn off the alarm.
Lose the cops, then fence the loot at Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn.

Sources disagree: The editorial pages only say Port Gellhorn; the mall name and landmarks come from Nerdschalk. GTABase lists one unlock but doesn't name it; only a reader comment says it opens Buck's pawn shop.
places.reward: Cash and jewellery from cases and the back-office safe
places.needs: Chapter 2; code is random per player (examples 3156, 5683). A sticky bomb can open the safe instead.

places.name: Firebreak SM-69 at Rusty Willis Jr. Hunting Supplies
places.area: North-west of Kalaga Reservoir, Lummox County
places.summary: A unique SM-69 sniper sold only here, for $3,890. Dexerto confirms the store and price; the store's position comes from fan guides. Where: Rusty Willis Jr. Hunting Supplies, the Hunting-tier gun store north-west of Kalaga Reservoir in Lummox County.
how: Drive to the gun store north-west of Kalaga Reservoir in Lummox County.
Buy the Firebreak SM-69 ($3,890).
Sources disagree: GTABase only says 'near Kalaga Reservoir'; games.gg says north-west of it.
places.statusNote: Dexerto confirms the gun and its $3,890 price; only fan guides say where the store is.

places.name: Gil's Kalinga .50 (Safe Word reward)
places.summary: Opening the practice safe at the end of 'Safe Word' gives Gil's Kalinga .50 pistol and $1,500. The safe is stolen from Gil's mansion in Peacock Estates. Dexerto confirms the reward; the place comes from GTABase. Where: At Raul's compound in Stockyard, where you practise on the stolen safe at the end of the Chapter 3 mission 'Safe Word'.
how: After 'Company Property', talk to Nicole at Raul's compound in Stockyard to start 'Safe Word' (Chapter 3).
Steal the practice safe from Gil's mansion in Peacock Estates (the remote is in the left desk drawer in his office) and deliver it to Felipe's garage.
Back at Raul's compound, drill the safe, guide the cable and hold the door to open it.
places.statusNote: Dexerto confirms the reward; only GTABase, a fan guide, gives the place.

places.name: Hunter's Laird 350 (hunting-accident event)
places.summary: Help two hunters (one has shot the other) and drive the injured one to hospital to receive this unique sniper rifle. The event is random and may not be active every visit. Where: A random roadside encounter with two hunters in the Grassrivers marsh south-west of Hamlet.
how: Look for the two hunters in the Grassrivers marsh south-west of Hamlet.
Agree to help and drive the injured hunter to the hospital.
Receive the Hunter's Laird 350.
places.needs: Random event; may not always spawn.

places.name: The Y Hotel, Room 701
places.summary: A free hotel-suite safehouse from Chapter 4, with a save point, concierge, ride service, Zenith Gym membership and a pool pergola. 'Company Cars' unlocks the nearby Thompson Court Garage (2 spots). Where: Room 701 of The Y Hotel, the Chapter 4 safehouse; GTABase places it in Ocean Beach.
how: Unlocks with the story at the start of Chapter 4 (mission 'Ocean Beach').
Talk to the concierge in 'Company Cars' to unlock Thompson Court Garage.
Sources disagree: GTABase and FandomWire say Ocean Beach; Beebom says Washington Beach. VGC confirms the Chapter 4 safehouse but gives no location.
places.statusNote: VGC names the safehouse; only fan guides say which district, and they disagree.

places.name: Pegassi Towers residence
places.summary: The last safehouse, unlocked in Chapter 5. Beebom says it unlocks after 'Operation Savage Glory' and comes with a 3-car storage garage. Where: A Pegassi tower penthouse, the Chapter 5 safehouse; FandomWire puts it in Tequesta Retreat.
how: Unlocks with the story in Chapter 5.
Sources disagree: FandomWire says Tequesta Retreat; Beebom says South Vice City. Names vary: Pegassi Tower (VGC), Pegassi Residences (Beebom), Pegassi Towers Residence (FandomWire).
places.statusNote: VGC names the safehouse; only fan guides say which district, and they disagree.

places.name: Jewelry store robberies (20 stores)
places.area: Mariana County (2), Vice-Dale County (15), Leonard County (3)
places.summary: Unlock after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. Displayed takes run $1,000-$25,000 (games.gg says up to $35,000 for three stores). Enter by the back door with the snap gun, then empty the cases and the safe. Where: Twenty jewelry stores: two in Mariana County, fifteen in Vice-Dale County (mostly Vice City) and three in Leonard County; none in Kelly County.
how: Mariana: The Siren's Chest (Key Lento, $1k-$10k), Victoria Lee Jeweler (Capri, $9k-$20k).
Vice-Dale, $14k-$25k: Donovan Banks & Co. (Downtown), Icegem, Blanc & Giroux (Decor District), Roval (Ocean Beach), Covgari, Akoya, Rococo Rich, Legendary Custom Jewelry.
Vice-Dale, lower: Plush, All That Glitters, Peacock (Peacock Bay), Marshal's ($9k-$20k); Richardson ($4.5k-$12k); The Jewelry Place, Crown Jewels ($1k-$10k).
Leonard: Brilliant Cuts (Belville, $9k-$20k), Skala, Kowalski ($14k-$25k).
Story-job safe codes: Richardson 6815, Donovan Banks 0104, Casa de Empeño (pawn) 1680. Free-roam safe codes are random.

Sources disagree: store names, districts and takes come from fan guides; Game Rant confirms only the story-job codes. games.gg lists Blanc & Giroux, Royal and Covgari at $14k-$35k and the others at $14k-$25k, and spells Roval as Royal.
District labels: Downtown, Ocean Beach, Peacock Bay and Belville come from GTA6Daily; Capri and Decor District from gta6.house.
places.reward: $1,000-$25,000 displayed take per store; sell jewelry to Yasmani in Little Cuba
places.needs: Chapter 3; snap gun for quiet back-door entry; sticky bombs as a loud fallback.
places.statusNote: Game Rant and PC Gamer confirm the robberies; the list of 20 stores comes from fan guides.

places.name: Ammu-Nation gun stores (24)
places.summary: Almost every gun store sells its own unique weapon (PC Gamer). Stock tiers: Limited (1), Standard (15), Hunting (2), Expanded (6). Where: Twenty-four gun stores across Leonida, shown as gun icons once the area is uncovered; six Expanded stores carry snipers, machine guns and launchers.
how: Mariana: Chuck's Tackle & Shot (Key Lento, Limited), Barrage Gun Supply (Southwind), Guns Aplenty! (Watson Bay, Hunting), Richardson Hunting Supplies (North Mariana), Woodhatch (Capri, Expanded).
Expanded stores: Woodhatch (Capri), Big Shots (Hamlet), Phil's Ammu-Nation (Southside), Black Eagle (Balsero, by Griffin Shooting Range), Iron & Oak (Stockyard), Prestige Firearms (Ocean Beach).

Other Vice-Dale stores: Hamlet Traders, Tequesta Guns & Ammo, Vice City Firearms (Salton), Martez Empenos (Little Cuba), Jackson Firearms (SE Balsero), Vice City Gun & Pawn (Rockridge), Pawn & Gun (Crosstown), Quickscope (Downtown), Zenon's Pawn Shop (La Perle).

Elsewhere: Pawn & Gun and Gellhorn Outfitters (Port Gellhorn), Biff's Gun Supply (Ambrosia, by Lake Leonida), Tactical Outlet Guns (Leonard), Rusty Willis Jr. Hunting Supplies (NW of Kalaga Reservoir, Lummox, Hunting).
Sources disagree: games.gg puts Biff's Gun Supply in Kelly County even though it says Ambrosia. Fan guides say some launch-day guides count 26 stores, not 24 (not checked).
places.reward: Weapons, ammo, mods, masks, body armor, parachutes; one unique gun at most stores
places.needs: Some guns need a BuckMe bank account; heavy weapons only at Expanded stores.
places.statusNote: PC Gamer confirms the stores; the list of 24 and their places come from games.gg, a fan site.

places.name: Phil's Ammu-Nation (Southside)
places.summary: An Expanded gun store with five bundles, including the unique Honky Tonk Mustang .357 and Star Spangled 556. Its locked back office holds two free basic guns, but breaking in sets off the alarm. Where: In the small Southside neighbourhood just south of Vice City International Airport.
how: Bundles: Klose K17 MCD $5,055, Girardi Super400 $7,445, ADB M350 machine gun $13,455 (browse menu); Honky Tonk Mustang .357 $3,780 and Star Spangled 556 $3,050 (display cases).
Break open the locked office in the far corner to steal a Duke 556 and a Girardi ES9; use the recorder there to delete camera footage.
Sources disagree: Game Rant lists the ADB M350 bundle at Phil's for $13,455; Dexerto says the ADB M350 is sold at Big Shots for $10,000.
places.reward: Unique Honky Tonk Mustang .357 and Star Spangled 556; free Duke 556 and Girardi ES9 from the office
places.needs: Cash; the office break-in triggers alarms and staff react.

places.name: Minigun: none found yet
places.summary: No GTA 6 minigun found. Dexerto's machine-gun list has only the ADB M350, Goodwin LMG 6 and Mercenary LMG 6, and the gta6.house weapons list has no minigun either. Heavy weapons found so far are the H-AT, the GLR40 and grenade launchers.
how: Nothing to do yet; recheck as guides fill in.
places.needs: Unconfirmed whether it exists in the game.
places.statusNote: Dexerto's gun list has no minigun, but no outlet has said outright that the game has none.

places.name: Mercenary LMG 6 (Port Vice City container)
places.summary: A unique Goodwin LMG 6 machine gun in a restricted cargo yard; coming in from the water avoids the security. Where: Inside a yellow 'Scoop' shipping container in the north of the Port Vice City cargo yard.
how: Approach the north of the Port Vice City cargo yard from the water.
Find the yellow Scoop container and break in to take the LMG.
places.needs: Restricted area (guards, wanted level if seen). Fan guides say a Chapter 3 tool is needed to open the container (not checked).

places.name: Annis Pixel Elegy
places.summary: A custom '90 Annis Elegy with its own design, from the Street Racer standout set. Its container is boxed in by a portable toilet and a crate. Where: In a yellow SCOOP container at the back of the Capri Construction Yard, on the waterfront just east of the pier.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool in Meet the Heders (Chapter 3).
Go to the Capri Construction Yard, east of the pier.
Use a heavy vehicle to push the portable toilet and crate away from the container.
Cut the lock and drive the Elegy out.
Sources disagree: Some guides say to move the blocking items with a telehandler; VICEscreen says a heavy truck. VICEscreen's entry was added by a crawler and has no player confirmations.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders). GTABase lists modern security (may need the Key Cloner). To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Royal Sanchez
places.area: Old rail yard northeast of Grassrivers, North Mariana County
places.summary: A custom Maibatsu Sanchez dirt bike with performance mods and its own livery (Race Bikes set). It shares the yard with the Caliente Picador. Where: In a container at the old rail yard just northeast of the Grassrivers map label, where the highway passes the yard.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3).
Go to the rail yard northeast of Grassrivers.
Find the bike's container and cut the lock.
Sources disagree: games.gg says the bike is in an orange container; other guides describe yellow SCOOP containers in the same yard.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders). To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Caliente Picador
places.area: Old rail yard northeast of Grassrivers, North Mariana County
places.summary: A hot rod built from a '72 Declasse Picador with flame decals (Hot Rods set). games.gg says the plate reads NVR L8. Where: In a boxed-in SCOOP container at the abandoned rail yard just northeast of the Grassrivers label.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3).
At the rail yard, use the yellow HVY bulldozer to push the grey and brown containers aside.
Cut the lock, open the doors and drive out.
Sources disagree: gta6map.io places it in a construction yard in the southern corner of Breakwater Quarry, North Mariana County; the in-game text says an old trainyard.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders). Bulldozer needed to clear the path. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Blue Drake Penumbra
places.summary: A track-ready Maibatsu Penumbra with a custom finish (Stock Car set). Its in-game description says it was found at Ambrosia Raceway, but guides do not agree on the exact spot.
how: If it is in a container, unlock the Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3) first.
Check Ambrosia Raceway, and the containers at Gellhorn Raceway.
Sources disagree: GTABase quotes the in-game text (Ambrosia Raceway). Sportskeeda and Game8, which I could not open, put it in a container at the Port Gellhorn/Gellhorn Raceway.
games.gg describes an unnamed red-and-pink race Penumbra in a SCOOP container at the north end of a South Kelly County race circuit; it may or may not be this car.
places.needs: Possibly the Cut-Off Tool. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Cuban Hermes
places.summary: A '50 Hermes with custom flame decals (Throwback set), hidden in a container. A user comment says a clue is on a PC in the dock office. Where: In a SCOOP container at the Draper Island docks; a user report gives Row 25, Tier 1 at 'Port Galahad Docks'.
how: Unlock the Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3).
Check the dock office PC for the clue (per the user report).
Use a telehandler to move the stacked containers, then cut the lock.

Sources disagree: GTABase's vehicle page calls it an Albany and gives Draper Island (in-game text). A GTABase user comment (repeated by Sportskeeda) calls it a Vapid at Port Galahad Docks, Row 25, Tier 1. It is unclear whether these are the same docks.
places.needs: Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders). Telehandler needed. GTABase lists modern security (may need the Key Cloner).

sources.publisher: GTABase (fan site, user comment on SCOOP map)

places.name: Pegassi Tempesta (Meet the Heders)
places.summary: A story-mission car. Lucia finds it for Raul, chases the container truck and drives it out. You hand it over and do not keep it; the mission unlocks the Cut-Off Tool. Where: In a yellow SCOOP container on top of the middle stack on the eastern side of the dockyard Lucia searches in Meet the Heders.
how: Start Meet the Heders (Chapter 3) as Lucia; take the white van into the docks in disguise.
Use Focus mode to find the SCOOP containers; cut open the top one in the middle stack.
Chase the truck on a bike, climb into the container, reverse the Tempesta out and deliver it to Raul.
Sources disagree: VGC says the tool opens orange SCOOP containers; most guides say yellow.
places.reward: Cut-Off Tool for Jason and Lucia. Keep-able Tempesta comes later as Raul's reward (see pegassi-tempesta-raul).
places.needs: Story mission, Chapter 3; police and gang pursuit.

places.name: Grotti Itali RSX (Vespucci Island garage)
places.summary: An Itali RSX supercar kept in a house garage. The garage door has an alarm and the car has an advanced tracker. Where: In the garage of the house on the bend on Vespucci Island; jump the fence and use the side door.
how: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).
Jump the fence of the house on the bend and enter the garage by the side door (it is alarmed).
Clone the key, drive out and deal with the tracker.

Sources disagree: May be the same car as the Dolce Vita RSX entry (a custom RSX at a Rialto Islands villa); no opened source confirms it. gta6.house also lists a Grotti Status RSX on a tow truck near Gellhorn International Raceway.
places.reward: Grotti Itali RSX supercar; also a Randy's Wish List car.
places.needs: Key Cloner; alarm; advanced tracker. Remove the tracker, then register with Moses.

places.name: Ascot Paragon (Banana Hole bar)
places.area: Shore Drive, Ocean Beach, Vice Beach
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List car GTA-Xtreme found outside the bar around 6 pm in-game. Where: In the spaces outside the Banana Hole Main Bar on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.
how: Visit the Banana Hole Main Bar around 6 pm in-game.
Clone the key if it is locked.
Sources disagree: Game Rant says the Paragon spawns randomly at homes in the rich part of Capri.
places.needs: Key Cloner likely; spawn not guaranteed.
places.statusNote: Game Rant confirms the car; only a fan site says where it parks.

places.name: Pfister Growler (Fig St car park)
places.area: Fig St multi-storey car park, Ocean Beach, Vice Beach
places.summary: A Randy's Wish List sports car. Push Square says multi-storey car parks in Vice Beach are a common spot and shows the Fig St one; GTA-Xtreme suggests about 5 pm in-game. Where: In the marked bays of the multi-storey car park on Fig St, Ocean Beach.
how: Go to the Fig St multi-storey around 5 pm in-game.
Check the marked bays on each level.
Clone the key if it is locked.
Sources disagree: Game Rant says Growlers are usually found driving around rich Capri.

places.name: Large helicopter at Lake Tallaloko
places.area: Lake Tallaloko, East Lummox County, north of Millport
places.summary: A large helicopter (gta6map.io names it a Buckingham Volatus) guarded by three armed men. Where: On the helipad by the Tallaloko Clubhouse inside the gated Lake Tallaloko community, north of Millport.
how: Enter the gated Lake Tallaloko community (trespassing).
Head to the helipad by the Tallaloko Clubhouse.
Deal with the three guards quietly, then fly off.
Sources disagree: The original report is from GameSpot, which I could not open.
places.reward: Large helicopter (reported as a Buckingham Volatus).
places.needs: Trespassing; three armed guards. gta6map.io says it is locked, with no alarm or tracker.

places.name: Luxury yachts at Leaf Links Country Club
places.area: Leaf Links Country Club, Vice-Dale County
places.summary: The best-known spot for large yachts. RetroBroker says no guards patrol the docks. Boats cannot be registered, so a stolen yacht is temporary. Where: Moored side by side at the Leaf Links Country Club docks, north of Vice City Beach and east of the Decor District.
how: Get the Key Cloner.
Go to the Leaf Links Country Club docks.
Clone the key on a yacht and sail away.
Sources disagree: Guides disagree on when the Key Cloner arrives: Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs) or Chapter 4.
places.needs: Key Cloner; yachts are cleared when you progress the story.

places.name: Kenton's charter boat
places.area: Island Dreams Boat Charters, Key Lento
places.summary: Kenton's dive boat, used in the Island Dreams mission. It carries scuba gear and is listed as the second free boat after Jason's own. Where: At the dock right next to Island Dreams Boat Charters, the yellow waterfront shop in Key Lento.
how: Finish Hey Arnold! in Chapter 1 to open Island Dreams.
Go to Island Dreams Boat Charters in Key Lento.
Take the boat from the dock next to the shop.
Sources disagree: Fan guides disagree on the boat's name.
places.reward: Free boat with scuba gear aboard.
places.needs: Cannot be registered or kept; no fuel pumps for boats found yet.

places.name: Tropical Manchez
places.area: Krystal Inc. Electronics, off SW 13th St, Southside
places.summary: A Maibatsu Manchez dirt bike customised by PTT Youngin$. Dexerto marks it as an Ultimate Edition reward. Where: In the back of the PTT Youngin$ illegal goods store (Krystal Inc. Electronics) off SW 13th St in northern Southside, beside the office.
how: Go to Krystal Inc. Electronics off SW 13th St.
Get to the back of the store beside the office and ride the bike out.
places.needs: Ultimate Edition (per Dexerto). PTT Youngin$ illegal operation site. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Speedy Boomazoom
places.summary: A souped-up Maibatsu Boomazoom scooter. Dexerto says it can appear in two spots. Where: In the small detached garage of a red house on the corner of NW 3rd Ave and NW 3rd St, Little Cuba.
how: Go to NW 3rd Ave and NW 3rd St in Little Cuba.
Open the red house's garage and ride it out.
places.needs: gta6map.io: unlocked, no alarm, no tracker. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Taci Ragno
places.summary: A retro-styled Taci motor scooter. Where: In the bushes beside the path from the Sands of Time Assisted Living & Memory Care facility to the beach.
how: Go to the Sands of Time care home in Vinewood Beach.
Follow the path toward the beach and check the bushes.
Sources disagree: Dexerto confirms the bike but gives its spot only on a map, not in text.
places.needs: gta6map.io: locked, no alarm, no tracker. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.
places.statusNote: Dexerto confirms the bike; only a fan map says where it is.

places.name: Ghost Cruiser
places.area: I-404, southern Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
places.summary: A Walter Cruiser bicycle painted white as part of a roadside memorial (Pedal Power set). Where: Leaning against the roadside memorial for Connie Hamilton under a pole beside I-404 in southern Port Gellhorn.
how: Drive along I-404 in southern Port Gellhorn.
Find the Connie Hamilton memorial and take the bike.
places.needs: gta6map.io: unlocked, no alarm, no tracker.

places.name: Magma Cliffhanger
places.area: Sweetbay Rd, Watson Bay, Mariana County
places.summary: A '72 Western Cliffhanger with a unique finish (Retro set). Where: Leaning against the southern of two abandoned waterfront cabins off Sweetbay Rd in Watson Bay.
how: Go to Sweetbay Rd in Watson Bay.
Check the southern abandoned cabin by the water.
places.needs: gta6map.io: locked, no alarm, no tracker. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: MyWays Manchez
places.area: Railroad bridge between Moreau and South West Lummox County
places.summary: A standout Maibatsu Manchez dirt bike. Where: On the edge of the railroad bridge over the water between Moreau and South West Lummox County (MacAlister Gold Mine area).
how: Go to the rail bridge between Moreau and South West Lummox County.
Take the bike from the bridge edge.
places.needs: gta6map.io: unlocked, no alarm, no tracker. To keep it, register with Moses (Chapter 2+) or at a Pay 'n' Spray.

places.name: Fountain of Youth
places.summary: A drinking fountain that gives all your stat bars a temporary boost when you drink from it. Lasting stat gains still need the gym.
how: Drink from the fountain when the prompt appears.

Sources disagree: A GTABase map search listing places it in Capri under a gazebo, but the map entry could not be read, and a YouTube guide that could not be read describes a lakeside promenade in Capri instead. Location left unplaced until confirmed.
places.reward: Temporary boost to all stats (one video title says Health, Stamina and Focus).

places.name: Unlimited Nitrous cheat
places.summary: Completing 50 stunt jumps unlocks the Unlimited Nitrous cheat. No button code has been published yet. Cheats only work after the story is finished, and using one disables saving and trophies.
how: Finish the main story.
Complete 50 of the 130 stunt jumps.
Enter cheats from a separate save to protect your main file.
Sources disagree: Push Square lists no input code for it (shown as a dash).

places.name: Niko Bellic cameo
places.summary: GTA IV's Niko Bellic appears, older and greyer, in the Chapter 5 story mission 'Taking Liberties'. Michael Hollick is credited as 'The Hitman'. He is in cutscenes only and is not playable.
how: Play the main story to Chapter 5 and the mission Taking Liberties.

places.name: 'Little Sam' (Sam Houser?) cameo
places.summary: In the Chapter 3 mission 'Boobie Time', a quiet bald, bearded man in a Rockstar Games shirt is introduced as 'Little Sam'. The credits list him as 'Himself'; fans read it as Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser, which Rockstar has not confirmed.
how: Play the Chapter 3 mission Boobie Time and watch the scene where Big Mike introduces Little Sam.
Sources disagree: GamesRadar's article body could not be read beyond the headline. Fan guides differ on whether Big Mike or Boobie introduces him.

places.name: Exploding beached whale
places.summary: A beached whale that explodes when you get close; the video shows what spills out of it. Where: On a beach near Gellhorn Raceway, according to a video title; exact spot not given in text.
how: Go to the beach by Gellhorn Raceway and walk up to the whale.
Sources disagree: Only a video title gives the location; one wiki says exploding whales can be found on beaches all over Leonida.

places.name: Capri warehouse demon ritual
places.area: Northern Capri, by Tortoise Lake (Mariana County)
places.summary: Drop a knocked-out NPC onto the blood pentagram: the lights die, your partner is possessed upstairs, hallucinations follow, and the body rises as a demon that only fire can hurt. Where: An abandoned warehouse in northern Capri just west of Top Fun Drones, above Tortoise Lake (the southern building of the cluster on the lake's left side), next to a construction site.
how: Read the altar book (it hints at fire).
Knock out a construction worker outside, carry them in and throw them onto the pentagram outline.
Go upstairs with a flashlight for the hallucination sequence.
Burn the demon with the Molotovs (1 upstairs, 2 in the ritual room) or the gas can by the altar.
Sources disagree: Some guides link the 'The Truth Is Out There' trophy to this ritual; Screen Rant says there are no rewards.
places.needs: A non-lethal takedown; both Jason and Lucia can do it.

places.name: 'ASS MAN' plate (Seinfeld)
places.summary: The story car carries a vanity plate reading 'ASS MAN' with a flamingo between the words, a nod to Kramer's plate in Seinfeld's 'The Fusilli Jerry'. Where: On the rear plate of the red Phoenix that Jason takes out of the Hamlet police impound in the Chapter 1 mission 'Unwanted Attention'.
how: During Unwanted Attention (Chapter 1), look at the rear plate of the Phoenix.
Sources disagree: Vice City DB says Eurogamer and Screen Rant reported it; those pages were not opened. Some write it as one word, ASSMAN.

places.name: Kingfishers hideout: Sunrise RV Park
places.area: North of Cottonmouth Lake, Grassrivers (Mariana County)
places.summary: The Kingfishers' biggest hideout, raidable from Chapter 2. Three safes, drug packs in the fishing store and a unique revolver. Where: The Kingfishers' trailer-park base north of Cottonmouth Lake in Grassrivers, the camp from the opening mission Gone Fishing.
how: Big safe in the fishing store by the docks: code 6769 (from a notebook in the big north cabin; it changes on later visits).
Small safe and the revolver in the central caravan; medium safe (no code) in the big cabin.
Escape on a Kingfisher boat.
places.reward: Kingfisher Akulus Revolver, safe cash and drugs (fan site: $6,500-$9,300).

places.name: Kingfishers hideout: Manatee Motel
places.area: South of Hamlet / Gullet Marsh edge (Mariana County)
places.summary: An early Kingfishers motel hideout. Break the safe and grab a free unique sniper rifle from the next room. Where: An abandoned motel south of Hamlet and north-east of Cottonmouth Lake.
how: Clear the motel.
Break open the safe in the room past the gap between rooms; the rifle case is to its left.
Search the other rooms for cash and cocaine.
places.reward: Kingfishers Laird 350 sniper, safe cash, cocaine; a Bravado Bison outside sells for $2,345.

places.name: Wyman's classic car wrecks
